en: DEMO{Symbol:1F}2{Symbol:1F}02{Symbol:1F}022
Ting along, tong along!{Symbol:0B}
cz: Cink cink, bam bam!{Symbol:0B}

en:
{Sound:02:0C}{04:10:00}Wow! That was fast work! But not so
fast that I didn't finish your sword!
Here, take a look! I call this new
blade the {Color:Red}White Sword{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:02:0C}{04:10:00}Pane! To byla rychla prace!
Ale ne tak rychla, abych ti
nedokoncil mec!
Podivej se! Tuto novou cepel
jsem nazval {Color:Red}Bily mec{Color:White}!

en:
Once you {Color:Blue}infuse it with the power of the
elements{Color:White}, it will become a {Color:Red}sacred blade{Color:White}!
The forest elder no doubt told you
this part, but...
If you want to infuse the sword, you
must go to the {Color:Green}elemental sanctuary{Color:White}.
The {Color:Green}sanctuary{Color:White} is a strange realm,
trapped between two worlds.
It is the bridge between the Minish
world and the human world.
The doorway to the {Color:Green}sanctuary {Color:White}opens
only once every hundred years!
You'll find that door hidden
within {Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White}.
Once the blade has been filled with
the power of the four {Color:Red}elements{Color:White},
you should be able to break the
curse on your princess.
I know you can do it. After all, you
made short work of that human mine.
Let me tell you about a shortcut you
can use to get down from the mountain.
You'll find it right in front of the
entrance of the mine you just explored.
Just follow that, and you'll be down
in no time. Good luck!
cz:
Az jej {Color:Blue}naplnis silou
zivlu{Color:White}, stane se z nej {Color:Red}posvatna cepel{Color:White}!
Stary z lesa ti to
jiste rekl, ale...
Pokud chces mec obohatit,
musis do {Color:Green}svatyne zivlu{Color:White}.
{Color:Green}Svatyne{Color:White} je zvlastni misto,
zachycene mezi dvema svety.
Je to most mezi svetem Minish
a svetem lidi.
Dvere do {Color:Green}svatyne {Color:White}se otevrou
jen jednou za sto let!
Ty dvere najdes ukryte
v {Color:Green}hrade Hyrule{Color:White}.
Az bude cepel naplnena silou
ctyr {Color:Red}zivlu{Color:White},
mel bys byt schopen zlomit
klatbu na tve princezne.
Vim, ze to zvladnes. S tim
dolem sis poradil rychle.
Reknu ti o zkratce, kterou se
muzes dostat z hory dolu.
Najdes ji hned pred vchodem
do dolu, ktery jsi prozkoumal.
Proste ji nasleduj a budes
dole raz dva. Hodne stesti!

en:
There's a simple way to get back to the
foot of the mountain...
All you have to do is go out through
here and jump off the cliff!
cz:
Existuje snadny zpusob, jak se
dostat k upati hory...
Staci jit tudy ven
a skocit z utesu!

en:
{04:10:07}{Sound:00:9B}Interesting. You're the last person
I expected to find here.
And just as I was wondering who could
be behind this, I find my old master...
cz:
{04:10:07}{Sound:00:9B}Zajimave. Tebe bych tu
cekal nejmene.
A prave kdyz jsem premyslel, kdo
za tim stoji, potkam sveho ucitele...

en: {Sound:01:E7}{Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}!
cz: {Sound:01:E7}{Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:01:E9}And, as always, you are dressed in...
heh heh heh...the shabbiest of rags.
My {Color:Blue}curses{Color:White} are not to be mocked. The
one I cast on you is most powerful.
No matter what power you wield, you
will never break it.
cz:
{Sound:01:E9}A jako vzdy jsi obleceny...
he he he...v tech nejhorsich hadrech.
Me {Color:Blue}klatby{Color:White} nejsou k smichu. Ta,
kterou jsem uvrhl na tebe, je nejmocnejsi.
At vladnes jakoukoli silou,
nikdy ji nezlomis.

en:
You haven't changed in the slightest.

I should never have created that {Color:Red}cap{Color:White}.
It only fueled your insane desires!
cz:
Vubec ses nezmenil.

Nikdy jsem nemel vytvorit ten {Color:Red}klobouk{Color:White}.
Jen podnitil tva silena prani!

en:
Fool! A hat that grants the wishes of
its wearer is a spectacular creation!
Thanks to you, I have gone from being
a meek, miniscule nothing to...
the greatest sorcerer alive!

You cannot stop me now, and
I have you to thank for it!
Accept this small gesture
of gratitude from me.
cz:
Blazne! Klobouk, ktery plni
prani sveho nositele, je uzasny!
Diky tobe jsem se z krotke,
malinkate niceho stal...
nejvetsim carodejem naziv!

Uz me nezastavis a
vdecim za to prave tobe!
Prijmi tento maly projev
vdecnosti ode me.

en: Wait! {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}, wait!!!
cz: Pockej! {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}, pockej!!!

en:
That foul {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}! What could he be
scheming now?
{Player}... I feel I owe you an
explanation of what has happened.
You see, Vaati and I are both {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}.

I was once a famous sage and a
renowned {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}craftsman.
Vaati was only a boy when I took him
on as my apprentice.
But...he became enchanted by the
wickedness in the hearts of men.
One day, Vaati took a hat I made for
the humans--my pride and joy.
It granted the wishes of its wearer.
He put it on without permission...
cz:
Ten hnusny {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}! Co asi
zase kuje?
{Player}... citim, ze ti dluzim
vysvetleni, co se stalo.
Vidis, Vaati a ja jsme oba {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}.

Kdysi jsem byl slavny mudrc a
znamy {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}remeslnik.
Vaati byl jen chlapec, kdyz
jsem ho vzal jako ucne.
Ale...ocaroval ho hrich
v srdcich lidi.
Jednoho dne vzal klobouk, ktery
jsem udelal pro lidi--mou pychu.
Plnil prani sveho nositele.
Nasadil si ho bez dovoleni...

en: {Sound:01:E7}{04:10:07}Oh! What a vile form you've taken!
cz:
{Sound:01:E7}{04:10:07}Ach! Jakou hnusnou podobu
jsi na sebe vzal!

en:
{Sound:00:9B}Vile? I am a sorcerer now, and my
power is beyond compare!
No longer will I tire away as your
apprentice!
Now, all shall call ME master!
cz:
{Sound:00:9B}Hnusnou? Ted jsem carodej a
ma moc je nesrovnatelna!
Uz nebudu drit jako
tvuj ucen!
Ted budou vsichni volat MNE ucitelem!

en: {04:10:06}Why, Vaati? What are you plotting?
cz: {04:10:06}Proc, Vaati? Co kujes?

en:
This year, on the day that comes but
once a century, the portal opens.
And when it does, I shall claim the
{Color:Red}light force {Color:White}as my own.
I will be transformed, perfect, and
there will be none who can stop me...
cz:
Letos, v den, ktery prijde
jen jednou za sto let, se otevre portal.
A az se tak stane, ziskam
{Color:Red}svetelnou silu {Color:White}pro sebe.
Budu promeneny, dokonaly a
nebude nikoho, kdo me zastavi...

en: GAAAAAA!!!
cz: GAAAAAA!!!

en:
{04:10:07}Ah ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!

Tell me, how does it feel,
my {Color:Blue}sorcerer's curse{Color:White}?
Do you see, Ezlo? I am truly your
master now, and you cannot stop me.
And with that, I must be leaving.
cz:
{04:10:07}Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!

Rekni mi, jaky je pocit
z me {Color:Blue}carodejnicke klatby{Color:White}?
Vidis, Ezlo? Ted jsem opravdu
tvuj ucitel a nezastavis me.
A s tim uz musim jit.

en:
Wait! Wait, I tell you!
{Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}!!!
cz:
Pockej! Pockej, rikam ti!
{Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}!!!

en:
You know the legends, of course. The
gifts the Picori gave the humans...
What you call the {Color:Red}Picori Blade{Color:White} was
the first of those gifts. The second...
Well, you call it {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}, but it is
a source of limitless magical power.
If {Color:Green}Vaati {Color:White}were to get it now, it would
be devastating.
I came to the world of men hoping to
stop Vaati, and I met you in the woods.
But it seems we won't be breaking
the curse on me anytime soon.
However, with the sacred blade, we can
certainly restore {Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White}.
I'm sorry. All that has happened has
been due to my own pride. My folly.
I must rely on you, on your power,
until we've put an end to Vaati.
cz:
Znas legendy, samozrejme. Dary,
ktere Picori dali lidem...
Cemu rikas {Color:Red}Picori cepel{Color:White}, byl
prvni z tech daru. Druhy...
Rikas tomu {Color:Red}svetelna sila{Color:White}, ale
je to zdroj bezmezne magicke moci.
Kdyby ji ted {Color:Green}Vaati {Color:White}ziskal,
bylo by to zdrcujici.
Prisel jsem do sveta lidi doufaje
ze zastavim Vaatiho, a potkal tebe v lese.
Ale zda se, ze klatbu na mne
hned tak nezlomime.
Nicmene s posvatnou cepeli muzeme
urcite obnovit {Color:Green}princeznu Zeldu{Color:White}.
Omlouvam se. Vse, co se stalo,
je kvuli me pyse. Me blaznivosti.
Musim se spolehnout na tebe, na tvou
silu, dokud neukoncime Vaatiho.

en:
Well, {Player}, enough fairy tales!
We must search for the next {Color:Red}element{Color:White}!
cz:
No, {Player}, dost pohadek!
Musime hledat dalsi {Color:Red}zivel{Color:White}!

en: Vaati! What are you doing?
cz: Vaati! Co to delas?

en:
Eh? What a strange feeling. I sensed
something from the castle's direction.
Or...was it just me?
cz:
Eh? Divny pocit. Neco jsem
vycitil ze smeru hradu.
Nebo...jsem to jen ja?

en:
{Sound:00:A3}Hm? Who's there?!?

What? Vaati! How did you get in here!?
cz:
{Sound:00:A3}Hm? Kdo je tam?!?

Co? Vaati! Jak ses sem dostal?!

en: Uhn... What are you doing?!?
cz: Uhn... Co to delas?!?

en: {Sound:00:9B}Ah ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!{Sound:00:A7}
cz: {Sound:00:9B}Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!{Sound:00:A7}

en:
{Sound:00:A9}It looks like you're all here. Very well.
The king of Hyrule has words for you.
cz:
{Sound:00:A9}Zda se, ze jste vsichni tady. Dobre.
Kral Hyrule ma pro vas slova.

en:
{Sound:00:A3}You all know of the power the Picori
gave to mankind, do you not?
The golden {Color:Red}light force{Color:White} of limitless
magical power...
I want it!!! It is somewhere here in
Hyrule! Go now, and bring me this power!
cz:
{Sound:00:A3}Vsichni vite o moci, kterou
Picori dali lidem, ze ano?
Zlata {Color:Red}svetelna sila{Color:White} bezmezne
magicke moci...
Chci ji!!! Je nekde tady v
Hyrule! Jdete a prineste mi ji!

en:
Waste no time! Go forth at once, and
bring me the {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}!
Fling anyone who refuses into the
dungeon! Him and his family, too!
I will tolerate no disobedience!

Now, search high and low throughout
the lands of Hyrule!
cz:
Nemarnete cas! Jdete okamzite
a prineste mi {Color:Red}svetelnou silu{Color:White}!
Toho, kdo odmitne, hodte do
dungeonu! Jeho i jeho rodinu!
Zadnou neposlusnost nestrpim!

A ted prohledejte krizem krazem
zeme Hyrule!

en:
Hmm... Maybe it's just the wind...
But I hope nothing bad has happened.
Anyway, we need to look for the next
{Color:Red}element{Color:White}.
The map says it should be
around here somewhere...
cz:
Hmm... Mozna to byl jen vitr...
Ale doufam, ze se nic zleho nestalo.
Stejne musime hledat dalsi
{Color:Red}zivel{Color:White}.
Mapa rika, ze by mel byt
nekde tady kolem...

en:
{Sound:00:AA}By the order of the king,
none shall pass!!
Now! Begone with you!!
cz:
{Sound:00:AA}Z rozkazu krale sem
nikdo nesmi!!
A ted! Zmiz odtud!!

en:
{Sound:00:AA}Hey, you!!

None may enter!
cz:
{Sound:00:AA}Hej, ty!!

Nikdo nesmi vstoupit!

en:
{Sound:00:AA}I have heard that this castle has
a {Color:Blue}secret entrance{Color:White}...
If you ever have need of it, you should
look for that {Color:Blue}entrance {Color:White}sometime...
cz:
{Sound:00:AA}Slysel jsem, ze tento hrad ma
{Color:Blue}tajny vchod{Color:White}...
Pokud jej nekdy budes potrebovat,
mel by ses po tom {Color:Blue}vchodu {Color:White}podivat...

en:
We are the {Color:Green}Tribe of the Winds{Color:White}.

Long have we lived with the winds. We
have mastered them. Now, we join them.
Together, with the great winds at our
backs, we head for the skies.
Those who come seeking our power must
play the {Color:Blue}notes{Color:White} Zeffa teaches.
May they lead you onward to
the power that you seek.
cz:
Jsme {Color:Green}Kmen vetru{Color:White}.

Dlouho jsme zili s vetrem. Ovladli
jsme jej. Ted se k nemu pridame.
Spolecne, s velkym vetrem v zadech,
mirime k obloze.
Ti, kteri prijdou hledat nasi moc,
musi zahrat {Color:Blue}noty{Color:White}, ktere Zeffa uci.
At te vedou dal k moci,
kterou hledas.

en:
{Sound:00:91}I do believe this is where the
{Color:Green}Tribe of the Winds{Color:White} once lived.
Hm... So they've left for the heavens,
and taken their {Color:Red}element{Color:White} with them.
It looks like the {Color:Red}Wind Element {Color:White}is beyond
our reach for the time being.
We have no choice but to press on.
Let's get out of here.
cz:
{Sound:00:91}Verim, ze zde kdysi zil
{Color:Green}Kmen vetru{Color:White}.
Hm... Takze odesli do nebe
a vzali si {Color:Red}zivel{Color:White} s sebou.
Vypada to, ze {Color:Red}Zivel vetru {Color:White}je
nyni mimo nas dosah.
Nemame na vyber nez pokracovat.
Pojdme odtud.

en:
{Sound:00:A3}Oh! {Player}! You have returned!
And have you found the Picori?
I see. And they want you to gather
the {Color:Red}four elements{Color:White}?
Well, it seems I must rely on you once
more if we are to restore Zelda.
Please, you must forge the
sacred blade anew, and quickly!
I am counting on you, {Player}!
cz:
{Sound:00:A3}Oh! {Player}! Ty ses vratil!
A nasel jsi Picori?
Aha. A oni chteji, abys nasbiral
{Color:Red}ctyri zivly{Color:White}?
Zda se, ze se musim znovu
spolehnout na tebe, mame-li obnovit Zeldu.
Prosim, musis znovu vykovat
posvatnou cepel a rychle!
Spoleham na tebe, {Player}!

en:
{Sound:00:A9}Oh! {Player}! Tell me, have you
been taking care of yourself?
cz:
{Sound:00:A9}Oh! {Player}! Rekni, staral
ses o sebe?

en:
{Sound:00:AA}What's that, {Player}? His Majesty
is in the room in back.
cz:
{Sound:00:AA}Co je, {Player}? Jeho Velicenstvo
je v mistnosti vzadu.

en:
{Sound:00:A3}Oh! {Player}? You have returned!
Welcome. Did you gather the elements?
What? A {Color:Green}sanctuary{Color:White}, you say? Why, I've
heard of no such thing in my castle!
cz:
{Sound:00:A3}Oh! {Player}? Ty ses vratil!
Vitej. Nasbiral jsi zivly?
Co? {Color:Green}Svatyne{Color:White}, rikas? Vzdyt jsem
o nicem takovem ve svem hrade neslysel!

en:
{Sound:00:A9}Hmmm... A {Color:Green}sanctuary{Color:White}...

You know, I do recall a story my
grandmother once told me long ago.
She said she saw a {Color:Blue}doorway{Color:White} appear in
the {Color:Blue}palace courtyard{Color:White} as a child.
If this door does indeed open only once
a century, it may be open even now!
As with the Picori themselves, the door
is visible only to the eyes of a child.
We might have walked past it recently
and never even known it was there...
cz:
{Sound:00:A9}Hmmm... {Color:Green}Svatyne{Color:White}...

Vis, vzpominam si na pribeh, ktery
mi kdysi davno vypravela babicka.
Rikala, ze jako dite videla
{Color:Blue}dvere{Color:White} objevit v {Color:Blue}nadvori palace{Color:White}.
Pokud se ty dvere skutecne otvirajji
jen jednou za sto let, mohou byt otevrene i ted!
Stejne jako Picori sami, dvere
jsou viditelne jen ocima ditete.
Mohli jsme kolem nich nedavno
projit a ani nevedet, ze tam jsou...

en:
{Sound:00:AA}A {Color:Green}sanctuary{Color:White}? No, I think I'd have seen
something like that in the castle...
cz:
{Sound:00:AA}{Color:Green}Svatyne{Color:White}? Ne, myslim, ze
bych neco takoveho v hrade videl...

en:
{Sound:00:AA}A {Color:Green}sanctuary{Color:White}? Hm... The {Color:Green}minister{Color:White}'s fairy
tales mention a sanctuary, I think...
cz:
{Sound:00:AA}{Color:Green}Svatyne{Color:White}? Hm... V pohadkach
{Color:Green}ministra{Color:White} se svatyne zminuji, myslim...

en:
{Sound:00:92}{Player}, look!
See how that doorway glows?
Could that be the door that
leads to the {Color:Green}sanctuary{Color:White}?
Nobody in the castle seems able
to see it but you and me...
Let's go! Quickly!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}{Player}, podivej!
Vidis, jak ty dvere zari?
Mohly by to byt dvere, ktere
vedou do {Color:Green}svatyne{Color:White}?
Zda se, ze v hrade je nikdo
nevidi, jen my dva...
Pojdme! Rychle!

en:
{Sound:00:A3}The doorway to the {Color:Green}elemental
sanctuary{Color:White} is in the castle courtyard?
All we adults see is just another
ordinary wall... Incredible!
Please, just gather the remaining two
{Color:Red}elements{Color:White} and repair the {Color:Red}sacred sword{Color:White}.
I'm counting on you, {Player}.
Never forget that.
cz:
{Sound:00:A3}Dvere do {Color:Green}svatyne
zivlu{Color:White} jsou na hradnim nadvori?
My dospeli vidime jen dalsi
obycejnou zed... Neuveritelne!
Prosim, jen nasbirej zbyvajici
dva {Color:Red}zivly{Color:White} a oprav {Color:Red}posvatny mec{Color:White}.
Spoleham na tebe, {Player}.
Nikdy na to nezapomen.

en:
{Sound:00:A9}Oh, ho! The doorway was indeed in the
garden? My grandmother was right!
Well, my family has always been known
for its honesty above all else.
But I still can't understand...

Why is it that children can see the
Picori and the doorway, but I cannot?
cz:
{Sound:00:A9}Oh, ho! Dvere byly opravdu
v zahrade? Babicka mela pravdu!
Moje rodina byla vzdy znama
svou uprimnosti nade vse.
Ale stejne nemuzu pochopit...

Proc deti vidi Picori
a dvere, a ja ne?

en: {04:10:07}{Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}! What are you doing there?
cz: {04:10:07}{Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}! Co tam delas?

en: Wh-wh-what?!?
cz: C-c-co?!?

en:
{Sound:02:0E}{Color:Blue}...   ...   

O young one...

Child who seeks to aid
the princess of Hyrule...
My name is Gustaf...

I was king of Hyrule, countless
ages ago.
Stand before me...

Only then will the path open
to you.
cz:
{Sound:02:0E}{Color:Blue}...   ...   

O mlade...

Dite, ktere se snazi pomoci
princezne Hyrule...
Me jmeno je Gustaf...

Byl jsem kralem Hyrule pred
nesmirnymi veky.
Stuj prede mnou...

Jen tak se ti otevre
cesta.

en:
Hmph! Was that...just a dream?
He said he was a king of Hyrule.
Wait! Look at your {Color:Red}map{Color:White}, {Player}.
There's some kind of mark on it.
Hm. I guess that means it wasn't
a dream!
We should head there once we've
infused your sword with that {Color:Red}element{Color:White}.
To the {Color:Green}elemental sanctuary{Color:White}!
cz:
Hmph! To byl...jen sen?
Rikal, ze byl kralem Hyrule.
Pockej! Podivej se na svou {Color:Red}mapu{Color:White}, {Player}.
Je na ni nejaka znacka.
Hm. Takze to nebyl
sen!
Meli bychom tam jit, jakmile
naplnime tvuj mec tim {Color:Red}zivlem{Color:White}.
Do {Color:Green}svatyne zivlu{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Hmm-hmm... Let's see if I can't
read that tablet for you...
{Color:Blue}Fill your sword with power and walk
over the glowing tile...{Color:White}
Hm... Perhaps it refers to those
{Color:Blue}flashing spots on the floor {Color:White}around you.
Well? What are you waiting
for? Try it, {Player}!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Hmm-hmm... Uvidime, jestli ti
tu desku dokazu precist...
{Color:Blue}Naplni svuj mec silou a projdi
pres zaricy obrazek...{Color:White}
Hm... Mozna se to tyka tech
{Color:Blue}blikajicich mist na podlaze {Color:White}kolem tebe.
No? Na co cekas?
Zkus to, {Player}!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Hmm-hmm...

It seems that forging the {Color:Red}sacred blade{Color:White}
somehow opened the doorway!
It must lead to the room that holds
the secret of the {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}!
{Player}, we must go inside!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Hmm-hmm...

Zda se, ze vykovani {Color:Red}posvatne cepele{Color:White}
nejak otevrelo dvere!
Musi vest do mistnosti, ktera drzi
tajemstvi {Color:Red}svetelne sily{Color:White}!
{Player}, musime dovnitr!

en:
{Sound:00:92}So, when that {Color:Blue}beam hits those who have
turned to stone, it will turn them back{Color:White}.
You've done it, {Player}!
Now, you can rescue {Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White}.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Takze kdyz ten {Color:Blue}paprsek trefi ty,
kteri se promenili v kamen, promeni je zpet{Color:White}.
Dokazal jsi to, {Player}!
Ted muzes zachranit {Color:Green}princeznu Zeldu{Color:White}.

en:
{Sound:00:8E}So this is the {Color:Green}elemental sanctuary{Color:White},
then...
This is where we can {Color:Blue}infuse your blade
with the power of the elements{Color:White}...
Yes, there seems to be a pedestal for
your sword right in the middle there.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Takze toto je {Color:Green}svatyne zivlu{Color:White},
tedy...
Zde muzeme {Color:Blue}napustit tvou cepel
silou zivlu{Color:White}...
Ano, vypada to, ze pro tvuj
mec je piedestal prave uprostred.

en:
{Sound:00:92}Whoa! You just {Color:Blue}split in two{Color:White}! So this
is the {Color:Blue}power of the White Sword{Color:White}!
I guess you can double yourself like
that anytime you see those panels...
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Fiiiuu! Ted ses {Color:Blue}rozdelil na dva{Color:White}!
Takze toto je {Color:Blue}sila Bileho mece{Color:White}!
Hadam, ze se muzes zdvojit
kdykoli uvidis takove panely...

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Hmmmm...
This inscription... It says...
{Color:Blue}Focus power in your blade and
stand on the glowing tile...
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Hmmmm...
Tento napis... Rika...
{Color:Blue}Soustred silu ve sve cepeli a
stan na zarici dlazdici...

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Hey, where are you going, {Player}?!
We must go through the door we opened!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Hej, kam jdes, {Player}?!
Musime projit dvermi, co jsme otevreli!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Hey, {Player}, you've gone too far!
Just step on those glowing panels!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Hej, {Player}, zasel jsi prilis daleko!
Proste stoup na ty zarici panely!

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Hmmm... How interesting... Look at the
images on the stained glass...
I bet those pictures show us where
the {Color:Red}light force{Color:White} is hidden...
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Hmmm... Zajimave... Podivej se na
obrazky na vitrazi...
Hadam, ze ty obrazky nam ukazuji,
kde je ukryta {Color:Red}svetelna sila{Color:White}...

en:
{Sound:01:E8}{04:10:0E}Ah ha ha haaaa...
Ezlo, you really are too kind.
First, you give me my {Color:Red}magic cap{Color:White},
and then you guide me here!
You've been far too generous, but
now, I no longer have any use for you.
cz:
{Sound:01:E8}{04:10:0E}Ha ha ha haaaa...
Ezlo, jsi opravdu prilis laskavy.
Nejdriv mi das muj {Color:Red}kouzelny klobouk{Color:White},
a pak me sem dovedes!
Byl jsi az prilis stedry, ale
ted uz te nepotrebuji.

en:
{Sound:01:E8}{04:10:0E}He ha ha ha ha... At last, I finally
know the location of the {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:01:E8}{04:10:0E}He ha ha ha ha... Konecne
znam misto {Color:Red}svetelne sily{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:92}{Player}! Wake up! Can't you
wake up, {Player}!?
cz:
{Sound:00:92}{Player}! Vstavej! Nemuzes
se probudit, {Player}!?

en:
{Sound:00:8E}{Color:Green}Vaati {Color:White}disguised himself as the king
to search for the {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}.
When he learned of this place, he
waited for us to reforge the blade.
If that stained glass is accurate,
{Color:Blue}Princess Zelda holds the light force{Color:White}!
Vaati will do whatever it takes to
steal that power from her!
If he succeeds, we may never be able
to return the princess to normal!
We've wasted too much time, {Player}!
We must stop Vaati!
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}{Color:Green}Vaati {Color:White}se prevlekl za krale,
aby hledal {Color:Red}svetelnou silu{Color:White}.
Kdyz se dozvedel o tomto miste,
cekal, az znovu vykuji cepel.
Pokud je ta vitraz presna,
{Color:Blue}princezna Zelda drzi svetelnou silu{Color:White}!
Vaati udela cokoli, aby ji
tu moc ukradl!
Pokud uspeje, mozna nikdy
nevratime princeznu do normalu!
Ztratili jsme prilis casu, {Player}!
Musime zastavit Vaatiho!

en:
{Sound:01:E8}Ha ha ha!
You ARE persistent, aren't you?
cz:
{Sound:01:E8}Ha ha ha!
Jsi opravdu vytrvaly, ze?

en:
Heh heh heh heh heh heh...

So, you've come to stop my little
ceremony. Well, you're too late.
A mere {Color:Blue}three more chimes of the bell{Color:White}
will bring the ceremony to its end!
And with the third toll of the bell,
I will become like a {Color:Green}god{Color:White}!
And your precious {Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White} will
be nothing more than cold, dead stone.
cz:
He he he he he he...

Takze jsi prisel zastavit muj
maly obrad. No, prisel jsi pozde.
Jen {Color:Blue}tri dalsi udery zvonu{Color:White}
privedou obrad k zaveru!
A s tretim udrem zvonu se
stanu jako {Color:Green}buh{Color:White}!
A tva drahocenna {Color:Green}princezna Zelda {Color:White}nebude
nic vic nez chladny, mrtvy kamen.

en:
{Sound:00:92}There's no time! Quickly, {Player},
to the roof!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Neni cas! Rychle, {Player},
na strechu!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Did you hear that, {Player}?
Hurry! There are {Color:Blue}only two chimes left{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Slysel jsi to, {Player}?
Rychle! {Color:Blue}Zbyvaji jen dva udery{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:92}Another bell has tolled...

{Color:Blue}Just one more chime{Color:White}, and all our
work will have been for naught!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Dalsi zvon zaznel...

{Color:Blue}Jeste jeden uder{Color:White} a vsechna
nase prace bude marna!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}{Player}! No, it can't be! The bell has
rung for a third time!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}{Player}! Ne, to nemuze byt!
Zvon zazvonil potreti!

en:
{Sound:01:E8}Hmph! Just a few more moments, and the
ceremony would have been complete.
You really are obsessed with stopping
me, aren't you? Ah, very well.
I have not yet drained all of the {Color:Red}light
force{Color:White} housed in Princess Zelda.
But what I have should suffice...
I shall be transformed! Unstoppable!
But let me first attend to the pesky
worms who would trifle with me...
cz:
{Sound:01:E8}Hmph! Jeste par okamziku a
obrad by byl dokoncen.
Jsi opravdu posedly tim, abys me
zastavil, ze? Ah, dobre.
Jeste jsem nevycerpal celou
{Color:Red}svetelnou
silu{Color:White} v princezne Zelde.
Ale to, co mam, bude stacit...
Budu promeneny! Nezastavitelny!
Ale nejprve se postaram o otravne
cervy, kteri si na me hraji...

en: Hmph!
cz: Hmph!

en:
{04:10:00}{Sound:01:E9}I will have no more of you interfering
with my plans!
Let me show you true power!!
cz:
{04:10:00}{Sound:01:E9}Uz nedovolim, abys zasahoval
do mych planu!
Ukazu ti pravou moc!!

en:
{04:10:0E}{Sound:00:9B}Well, you seem to have some fight in
you. I commend your bravery.
But you will not survive...THIS!!
cz:
{04:10:0E}{Sound:00:9B}Vypada to, ze mas v sobe
nejaky boj. Chvalim tvou odvahu.
Ale toto...NEPREZIJES!!

en:
{04:10:0E}{Sound:00:9B}Grrrrr.....
I am filled with a power that you cannot
begin to understand! Do you think that
puny sword will save you from ME?!
cz:
{04:10:0E}{Sound:00:9B}Grrrrr.....
Jsem naplneny silou, ktere ani
nezacnes rozumet! Myslis, ze ten
mrnavy mec te pred MNOU zachrani?!

en:
{Sound:00:92}You did it! Impressive! Now, quickly!
We must break the curse on {Color:Green}Zelda{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Dokazal jsi to! Ohromujici! Rychle!
Musime zlomit klatbu na {Color:Green}Zelde{Color:White}!

en:
What... What is this madness?

I have the power of a god!

I have unstoppable might!!!

How could I lose to a child?!?
cz:
Co... Co je toto silenstvi?

Mam moc boha!

Mam nezastavitelnou silu!!!

Jak jsem mohl prohrat s ditetem?!?

en:
{Sound:01:E3}{Player}, thank you so much for
saving me.
When I was turned to stone, I saw
visions of you, as if in a dream.
cz:
{Sound:01:E3}{Player}, mockrat ti dekuji,
ze jsi me zachranil.
Kdyz jsem byla promenena v kamen,
videla jsem vize o tobe, jako ve snu.

en:
{Sound:01:DF}Oh! That {Color:Red}shield{Color:White}! I...remember it...

You still have it? That's so sweet!
I knew I could count on you.
cz:
{Sound:01:DF}Oh! Ten {Color:Red}stit{Color:White}! Ja...si na nej vzpominam...

Jeste ho mas? To je tak roztomile!
Vedela jsem, ze na tebe muzu spolehnout.

en:
{Sound:00:90}It looks like the curse has been
broken. I'm glad we made it in time.
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Vypada to, ze klatba je
zlomena. Jsem rad, ze jsme to stihli vcas.

en:
{Sound:00:8D}No! The castle's collapsing!

It's too dangerous here. Quickly!
We must escape from the castle!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Ne! Hrad se hrouti!

Je tu prilis nebezpecno. Rychle!
Musime uniknout z hradu!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}Hrmm... The door is blocked! We have no
choice... Head back to the {Color:Green}sanctuary{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Hrmm... Dvere jsou zablokovane! Nemame
vyber... Vratme se do {Color:Green}svatyne{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:8D}So, {Player}! Now that you have the
power of the {Color:Red}Four Sword{Color:White}...
you must return {Color:Green}Princess Zelda {Color:White}to
normal!
cz:
{Sound:00:8D}Takze, {Player}! Ted, kdyz mas moc
{Color:Red}Ctyr mecu{Color:White}...
musis vratit {Color:Green}princeznu Zeldu {Color:White}do
normalu!

en:
{Sound:00:9B}{Player}! And you, Ezlo!

I will not let you escape this place
alive...
Witness the power of Vaati's Wrath!
I have transcended! I am all there is!
Allow me to give you a taste of pure
power, of unstoppable might!
cz:
{Sound:00:9B}{Player}! A ty, Ezlo!

Nedovolim vam uniknout odtud
zivi...
Budte svedky sily Vaatiho hnevu!
Prekonal jsem vse! Jsem vsim!
Dovolte mi dat vam ochutnat cistou
moc, nezastavitelnou silu!

en:
{Sound:01:E8}Heh heh heh heh...
You will not escape, boy.
Now, you will see the true power of
the {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}...
For I have become Vaati,
the master of this world!
cz:
{Sound:01:E8}He he he he...
Neutecess, chlapce.
Ted uvidis pravou moc
{Color:Red}svetelne sily{Color:White}...
Stal jsem se Vaatim,
vladcem tohoto sveta!

en:
{04:10:07}Fool! I... But the {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}...
My power... I had such power...
cz:
{04:10:07}Blazne! Ja... Ale {Color:Red}svetelna sila{Color:White}...
Moje moc... Mel jsem takovou moc...

en:
{Sound:01:E3}{Player}, thank goodness you're
safe...
You defeated Vaati...
You were so brave!
But we've lost so much...
The castle... All those people...
cz:
{Sound:01:E3}{Player}, diky bohu, ze jsi
v bezpeci...
Porazil jsi Vaatiho...
Byl jsi tak statecny!
Ale ztratili jsme tolik...
Hrad... Vsichni ti lide...

en:
{Sound:01:E7}What's this?

The curse... Defeating Vaati seems to
have broken the curse he cast upon me!
cz:
{Sound:01:E7}Co je to?

Klatba... Zdolani Vaatiho zrejme
zlomilo klatbu, kterou na me uvrhl!

en:
{Sound:01:E6}Allow me to introduce myself
to you, Princess Zelda.
My name is {Color:Green}Ezlo{Color:White}, master of Minish
lore and sorcery.
The mage's cap was my creation.

But its limitless power has caused
nothing but trouble for your kind.
Is there any way you can forgive me?

I know many have fallen, and much of
the castle has been destroyed...
But it is too soon to give
in to despair.
The curse on me is broken, and Zelda
still possesses some of the light force.
Perhaps, together, we can do
something to make things right.
cz:
{Sound:01:E6}Dovol mi se ti predstavit,
princezno Zeldo.
Me jmeno je {Color:Green}Ezlo{Color:White}, mistr Minish
vedomosti a carodejnictvi.
Magovsky klobouk byl mym dilem.

Ale jeho nekonecna moc zpusobila
tveho druhu jen potize.
Muzes mi nejak odpustit?

Vim, ze mnozi padli a velka cast
hradu byla znicena...
Ale je prilis brzy propadnout
zoufalstvi.
Klatba na me je zlomena a Zelda
jeste ma cast svetelne sily.
Mozna spolu muzeme neco
udelat, aby to bylo napraveno.

en:
{Sound:01:E6}If one with a just heart wears this
cap, things can be made right again.
cz:
{Sound:01:E6}Pokud si spravedlive srdce oblece
tento klobouk, vse muze byt napraveno.

en:
{Sound:01:E5}Princess Zelda!
Let your wishes be made real!
cz:
{Sound:01:E5}Princezno Zeldo!
At se tva prani stanou skutecnosti!

en:
{Sound:01:E6}Hmm-hmm!

The hat is falling apart. It's
overflowing with the power of life!
The hat has the power to turn the
thoughts of its wearer into reality.
Vaati's heart was filled with evil, and
that was reflected in what he became.
But it seems that Zelda's pure heart,
coupled with the hat's power...
...has created a miracle!
cz:
{Sound:01:E6}Hmm-hmm!

Klobouk se rozpada. Preteka
silou zivota!
Klobouk ma moc promenit
myslenky nositele ve skutecnost.
Vaatiho srdce bylo naplneno zlem
a to se odrazilo v tom, cim se stal.
Ale zda se, ze ciste srdce Zeldy,
spolu s moci klobouku...
...vytvorilo zazrak!

en:
{Sound:01:E6}Hmm... It looks like the time for us
to part has come.
The Minish Door opens but once every
century, and soon, it must close.
I must leave you both now and return
to my homeland.
I know I've caused you much suffering,
but the evil one's power has withered.
The power of Princess Zelda herself
has restored the light to Hyrule.
cz:
{Sound:01:E6}Hmm... Vypada to, ze prisel cas,
abychom se rozloucili.
Dvere Minish se otviraji jen
jednou za sto let a brzy se musi zavrit.
Musim vas oba ted opustit
a vratit se do sve domoviny.
Vim, ze jsem vam zpusobil mnoho utrpeni,
ale moc zleho jiz odumrela.
Moc same princezny Zeldy
vratila svetlo do Hyrule.

en:
{04:10:00}Well, {Player}, my journey with you
has been exciting, to say the least.
In fact, I'm...more than just a little
sad that we must part ways now.
cz:
{04:10:00}Nu, {Player}, cesta s tebou
byla prinejmensim vzrusujici.
Uprimne...jsem vic nez jen trochu
smutny, ze se musime rozejit.

en: {04:10:00}Please, accept this...
cz: {04:10:00}Prosim, prijmi toto...

en:
Take care...
{09:78}
cz:
Opatruj se...
{09:78}

en:
{Sound:01:E0}{04:10:0E}Look! The castle! All the people who
had been turned to stone!
They're all back to normal!
cz:
{Sound:01:E0}{04:10:0E}Podivej! Hrad! Vsichni lide,
kteri byli promeneni v kamen!
Vsichni jsou zase v normalu!

en:
Farewell, my friend...
{09:78}
cz:
Sbohem, muj prately...
{09:78}

en:
{Sound:02:0E}...   ...

{Color:Blue}O young one...

Child who seeks to rescue my
descendant, Zelda...
Welcome...

My name is {Color:Green}Gustaf{Color:Blue}. I was king of
Hyrule countless ages ago...
cz:
{Sound:02:0E}...   ...

{Color:Blue}O mlade...

Dite, ktere se snazi zachranit
mou potomkyni, Zeldu...
Vitej...

Me jmeno je {Color:Green}Gustaf{Color:Blue}. Byl jsem kralem
Hyrule pred nesmirnymi veky...

en:
{Color:Blue}I grant to you this {Color:Red}Kinstone{Color:Blue}...

Seek the {Color:Green}source of the flow {Color:Blue}in Hyrule...

Only then will your path open...

Save {Color:Green}Zelda{Color:Blue}...

All of Hyrule is counting on you...
cz:
{Color:Blue}Udeluji ti tento {Color:Red}Kamen osudu{Color:Blue}...

Hledej {Color:Green}zdroj proudu {Color:Blue}v Hyrule...

Jen tak se ti otevre cesta...

Zachran {Color:Green}Zeldu{Color:Blue}...

Cele Hyrule na tebe spoleha...

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Hmm... Fascinating! An ancient
king of Hyrule? How strange...
And the {Color:Green}source of the flow{Color:White}?
What do you suppose that could mean?
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Hmm... Fascinujici! Starobyly
kral Hyrule? Jak zvlastni...
A {Color:Green}zdroj proudu{Color:White}?
Co asi to muze znamenat?

en:
Let fools tarry here while
the true hero moves forward...
The truth is not seen by the eye,
yet it makes itself known.
cz:
At blazni otaleji zde, zatimco
opravdovy hrdina jde vpred...
Pravda neni videna okem,
prece se dava vedet.

en:
I love working in my garden. It makes
me feel so close to nature...
And sometimes, just sometimes, I dig up
a {Color:Red}Kinstone {Color:White}from the ground!
cz:
Miluji praci na sve zahrade. Delam
se tak blizko prirode...
A nekdy, jen nekdy, vykopu
{Color:Red}Kamen osudu {Color:White}ze zeme!

en:
What's up there, bud? You sayin' you
wanna match {Color:Red}Kinstone pieces{Color:White}?
cz:
Co je, kamosi? Rikas, ze chces
spojit {Color:Red}kousky Kamene osudu{Color:White}?

en:
What? Not interested?
All right, that's cool.
cz:
Co? Nemas zajem?
Dobre, v pohode.

en: Well, look at that! A perfect fit!
cz: No, koukni na to! Presne sedne!

en:
Hmn? Hey, did you just feel
the earth move?
cz:
Hmn? Hej, taky jsi ted citil,
jak se zeme pohnula?

en:
Thanks, pal! I feel like a lean,
mean, earth-tillin' machine!
cz:
Diky, kamose! Citim se jako
stihly, drsny orajici stroj!

en:
Rock and roll! I dug up another
{Color:Red}Kinstone piece {Color:White}from my field!
That rocks!
cz:
Rock and roll! Vykopal jsem dalsi
{Color:Red}kousek Kamene osudu {Color:White}z pole!
To je super!

en:
Wanna {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstone pieces{Color:White}?
Yeah, rock n' roll!
cz:
Chces {Color:Blue}spojit kousky Kamene osudu{Color:White}?
Jo, rock n' roll!

en:
Boo! You know what you get for
quitting on me? You get a BOOO!
cz:
Fuj! Vis, co dostanes za to,
ze me nechas? Dostanes FUJJ!

en:
Fits like a chip off the ol' rock!
Oh, rock and rolllll!
cz:
Sedne to jako trisky ze skaly!
Oh, rock and rolllll!

en: Rock, rock, rock and roll!
cz: Rock, rock, rock and roll!

en:
Welcome to Mount Crenel.
I am the {Color:Green}Great Butterfly Fairy{Color:White}.
I shall increase the size of the
{Color:Red}wallet{Color:White} you carry.
cz:
Vitej na hore Crenel.
Jsem {Color:Green}Velka motyli vila{Color:White}.
Zvetsim ti velikost
{Color:Red}penezenky{Color:White}, kterou nosis.

en:
Welcome to Mount Crenel. I am the
{Color:Green}Great Mayfly Fairy{Color:White}.
I shall increase the size of the 
{Color:Red}bomb bag{Color:White} you carry.
cz:
Vitej na hore Crenel. Jsem
{Color:Green}Velka jepici vila{Color:White}.
Zvetsim velikost {Color:Red}pytle na bomby{Color:White},
ktery nosis.

en:
Welcome to Mount Crenel. I am the
{Color:Green}Great Dragonfly Fairy{Color:White}.
I shall increase the capacity of the
{Color:Red}quiver{Color:White} you carry.
cz:
Vitej na hore Crenel. Jsem
{Color:Green}Velka vazkova vila{Color:White}.
Zvetsim kapacitu {Color:Red}toulce{Color:White},
ktery nosis.

en:
The name's {Color:Green}Mutoh{Color:White}. I'm head carpenter
'round these parts.
The king of Hyrule has entrusted me
with the town's reconstruction.
This area you're standing in right
now? It's a work zone!
It's way too dangerous for a little
kid like you.
cz:
Jmenuji se {Color:Green}Mutoh{Color:White}. Jsem hlavni
tesar tady.
Kral Hyrule me poveril
rekonstrukci mesta.
Tato oblast, ve ktere ted stojis?
Je to pracovni zona!
Je to prilis nebezpecne pro
malicke dite jako ty.

en:
{Sound:00:B5}The name's {Color:Green}Mutoh{Color:White}. I'm head carpenter
'round these parts.
The king of Hyrule himself has
entrusted me with this project.
See, that sorcerer's attack tore
things up pretty bad around here.
You know, kid, you shouldn't be playing
anywhere near the construction zone.
cz:
{Sound:00:B5}Jmenuji se {Color:Green}Mutoh{Color:White}. Jsem hlavni
tesar tady.
Sam kral Hyrule me poveril
timto projektem.
Vidis, utok toho carodeje
tady vse hodne poskodil.
Vis, kluku, nemel bys si hrat
nikde v blizkosti stavebni zony.

en:
So, that Picori Blade was just a lock
keeping those monsters in that chest?
The rumor is that Vaati was looking for
something inside the chest...
I mean, something other than monsters.
But nobody knows for sure what it is.
I tell you, he sure has been nothing
but a big headache to the rest of us.
cz:
Takze ta Picori cepel byla jen zamek,
ktery drzel ta monstra v truhle?
Rika se, ze Vaati hledal neco
uvnitr truhly...
Myslim, neco jineho nez monstra.
Ale nikdo nevi jiste, co to je.
Rikam ti, byl to jen velky
bolehlav pro nas ostatni.

en:
We've taken care of most of the
monsters out here.
Be careful around {Color:Green}Minish Woods{Color:White},
though. The woods are thick with 'em.
cz:
Postarali jsme se o vetsinu
monster tady venku.
Bud opatrny v {Color:Green}Minish lesich{Color:White},
ale. Ty lesy jsou jich plne.

en:
{Sound:00:CA}Hooo! I'm busy, kid!

The boss always makes sure we've got
our noses to the ol' grindstone.
cz:
{Sound:00:CA}Hooo! Mam praci, kluku!

Sef vzdy zajisti, abychom
dreli az do umoreni.

en:
{Sound:00:CA}Ahh! No time to talk, kid!

The boss has us working our fingers to
the bone! No time for a break, even!
cz:
{Sound:00:CA}Ahh! Nemam cas mluvit, kluku!

Sef nas nechava drit do padnuti!
Ani chvilku pauzy!

en:
{Sound:00:C0}There have been a lot of creatures on
the rampage lately.
As a result, we're in a bit of a rush
to get things repaired around here.
cz:
{Sound:00:C0}V poslednich dnech se rozzurilo
mnoho stvureni.
Proto trochu spechame, abychom
vse tady opravili.

en:
{Sound:00:C0}That sorcerer was something else!

He really tore up the town, so we've
got a serious backlog of work to do.
cz:
{Sound:00:C0}Ten carodej byl neco jineho!

Opravdu roztrhal mesto, takze
mame vazny naval prace.

en:
{Sound:00:CA}Creepy... It's like all these monsters
just appeared out of nowhere...
cz:
{Sound:00:CA}Divne... Jako by se vsechna
ta monstra objevila odnikud...

en:
{Sound:00:C0}I'm so busy! So busy!

Gotta finish here, so I can go
repair the steps next!
cz:
{Sound:00:C0}Mam tolik prace! Tolik prace!

Musim to tady dodelat, abych
mohl jit dal opravit schody!

en:
Ah, we've got the {Color:Red}Earth Element{Color:White}!
You must go tell the {Color:Green}elder{Color:White} at once!
cz:
Ach, mame {Color:Red}Zemsky zivel{Color:White}!
Musis okamzite jit rici {Color:Green}starsimu{Color:White}!

en:
Oh, that was hot! It was so hot,
I thought my fibers would catch fire!
Ah, but it's over now! I suppose we
should go back and speak to {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White}.
cz:
Ach, to bylo horko! Bylo to tak horko,
ze jsem myslel, ze mi vlakna chytnou!
Ach, ale ted je po vsem! Asi bychom se
meli vratit a promluvit s {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White}.

en:
The element was not here, but at least
we now have a clue to its whereabouts.
You must use the {Color:Red}Ocarina of Wind{Color:White} to
open a new path.
Well, there's no point in standing
around! Go get that last element!
cz:
Zivel tady nebyl, ale aspon
ted mame stopu, kde je.
Musis pouzit {Color:Red}Okarinu vetru{Color:White},
abys otevrel novou cestu.
Nema smysl tady stat!
Bez pro ten posledni zivel!

en:
Brrrrrrrrr... I almost froze my
beak off in there!
cz:
Brrrrrrrrr... Skoro mi tam
umrznul zobak!

en:
At last, we've got all four elements!
Let's go revive the {Color:Red}sacred blade{Color:White}!
cz:
Konecne mame vsechny ctyri zivly!
Pojdme obnovit {Color:Red}posvatnou cepel{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:01:B8}MYAAAAWWWN!!

{Sound:01:B7}What a nap!!
cz:
{Sound:01:B8}MYAAAAWWWN!!

{Sound:01:B7}To byl spanek!!

en:
{Sound:01:B9}Welcome. Goro.
Oh, what a tiny Goron you are...
You make this big Goron happy with this
unexpected visit to my distant home.
And yes, if you should ever accomplish
some major feat...
Well, then you should come back and
visit me again...
Don't forget.
cz:
{Sound:01:B9}Vitej. Goro.
Ach, jaky maly Goron ty jsi...
Udelal jsi tomuto velkemu Goronovi radost
necekanou navstevou meho vzdaleneho domova.
A ano, kdybys nekdy vykonal
nejaky velky cin...
Mel by ses vratit a
navstivit me znovu...
Nezapomen.

en:
{Sound:01:B8}Welcome. Goro.
Oh, what a tiny Goron you are...
You make this big Goron happy with this
unexpected visit to my distant home.
Tell me, little one, what do you know
about {Color:Red}shields{Color:White}?
Well, among us Gorons, who know well
the taste of steel...
They are considered a fine delicacy.
Ah, yes...
Just once, I should like to taste
a fine, fresh shield...
cz:
{Sound:01:B8}Vitej. Goro.
Ach, jaky maly Goron ty jsi...
Udelal jsi tomuto velkemu Goronovi radost
necekanou navstevou.
Rekni mi, maly, co vis
o {Color:Red}stitech{Color:White}?
Mezi nami Gorony, kteri dobre
znaji chut oceli...
Jsou povazovany za skvelou lahudku.
Ach, ano...
Jednou bych chtel ochutnat
dobry, cerstvy stit...

en:
{Sound:01:B9}Thank you for the delicious {Color:Red}shield {Color:White}you
gave me last time you came.
I think of that flavor even now... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
Sigh... Even thinking about it takes me
to faraway places.
If you ever find another such shield,
you must let me taste it, please!
cz:
{Sound:01:B9}Diky za vytecny {Color:Red}stit{Color:White}, ktery
jsi mi minule dal.
Jeste ted na tu chut myslim... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
Vzdych... I mysleni na to me vede
do vzdalenych mist.
Kdyz najdes jiny takovy stit,
musis mi ho dat ochutnat, prosim!

en:
{Sound:01:BA}Welcome. Goro.
Oh, what a tiny Goron you are...
You make this big Goron happy with this
unexpected visit to my distant home.
Oh! Oh, what is that you have there?
Is that by any chance a {Color:Red}shield{Color:White}?
Well, among us Gorons, who know well
the taste of steel...
They are considered a fine delicacy.
Little Goron! Please, goro!
Let me just nibble on the corner,
would you?
I will give it back to you just as soon
as I've had the tiniest taste.
Won't you please just let me have
a bite, a lick, a tiny crumb?
  {Choice:1D:06}OK!    {Choice:1D:07}No! Gross!
cz:
{Sound:01:BA}Vitej. Goro.
Ach, jaky maly Goron ty jsi...
Udelal jsi tomuto velkemu Goronovi radost
necekanou navstevou.
Ach! Co to tam mas?
Je to nahodou {Color:Red}stit{Color:White}?
Mezi nami Gorony, kteri dobre
znaji chut oceli...
Jsou povazovany za skvelou lahudku.
Maly Gorone! Prosim, goro!
Nech me okusnout jen rozek,
ano?
Vratim ti to, jakmile
budu mit nejmensi ochutnavku.
Nechal bys me si dat kousek,
srknuti, drobek?
  {Choice:1D:06}OK!    {Choice:1D:07}Ne! Fuj!

en:
{Sound:01:B7}Welcome. Goro.
Oh, what a tiny Goron you are...
Oh! What's this!?
You have another {Color:Red}shield{Color:White}?
Will you let me taste this one also?
  {Choice:1D:06}OK!    {Choice:1D:07}No! That's sick!
cz:
{Sound:01:B7}Vitej. Goro.
Ach, jaky maly Goron ty jsi...
Ach! Co to je!?
Mas dalsi {Color:Red}stit{Color:White}?
Nechas me ochutnat i tento?
  {Choice:1D:06}OK!    {Choice:1D:07}Ne! Fuj!

en:
{Sound:01:B8}But, little one, if I eat it, you will no
longer have a shield. Do you mind?
  {Choice:FF}No, it's fine!    {Choice:1D:07}Uh, just a little...
cz:
{Sound:01:B8}Ale, maly, kdyz to snim,
nebudes uz mit stit. Vadi ti to?
  {Choice:FF}Ne, je to v pohode!    {Choice:1D:07}Ehm, trochu...

en:
{Sound:01:B7}I see, goro. Then I will not taste your
delicious shield.
cz:
{Sound:01:B7}Chapu, goro. Pak neochutnam
tvuj vytecny stit.

en:
{Sound:01:BA}Really, goro!? Thank you! GORO!

I'll dig right in!!
cz:
{Sound:01:BA}Opravdu, goro!? Diky! GORO!

Hned se do toho pustim!!

en:
{Sound:01:B8}Nummnummnumm! Slurp, slurp!
Oh, delicious!
It has a deep, rich taste surpassing
even the great praise I have heard!
cz:
{Sound:01:B8}Namnamnam! Srk, srk!
Ach, delikatni!
Ma hlubokou, bohatou chut prekonavajici
i velkou chvalu, kterou jsem slysel!

en:
{Sound:01:B8}Nummnumm! Slurp, slurp! Oh, delicious!
Oh, just a few more bites, please!!
cz:
{Sound:01:B8}Namnam! Srk, srk! Ach, delikatni!
Ach, jeste par kousku, prosim!!

en:
{Sound:01:B8}Nummnumm! Slurp, slurp! Oh, delicious!
That was excellent!
Thank you so much. Now, I finally know
the legendary taste of a shield!
And I will happily fulfill my promise!

Let me just spit your {Color:Red}shield {Color:White}back
out again!
cz:
{Sound:01:B8}Namnam! Srk, srk! Ach, delikatni!
Bylo to skvele!
Mockrat diky. Ted konecne znam
legendarni chut stitu!
A rad splnim svuj slib!

Nech me plivnout tvuj
{Color:Red}stit {Color:White}zpatky ven!

en:
{Sound:01:B7}Goro goro...?!

It-It seems your shield has changed
{Color:Blue}shape {Color:White}a little as I was chewing on it...
Oh, but it's fine!

It is still a shield after all, just a
slightly differently shaped one!
I think...
Well, I have to go now! Good-bye, goro!
cz:
{Sound:01:B7}Goro goro...?!

Z-zda se, ze tvuj stit trosku
zmenil {Color:Blue}tvar{Color:White}, kdyz jsem ho zval...
Ach, ale je to v poradku!

Porad je to stit, jen s malinko
jinym tvarem!
Myslim...
Ted uz musim jit! Sbohem, goro!

en:
{Sound:01:FB}Green clothes? And a mystical hat?!?

Sir! Would you by chance be {Player},
the one who found the {Color:Red}Earth Element{Color:White}?
Surely you are! I have heard so many
tales about you.
I am {Color:Green}Belari{Color:White}, researcher of antiquities.
I am also, well, a bit of an inventor.
You know, you won't be able to get
back to town, due to all the debris...
Here, I have something that might
come in handy.
cz:
{Sound:01:FB}Zelene saty? A magicky klobouk?!?

Pane! Nejsi ty nahodou {Player},
ten, kdo nasel {Color:Red}Zemsky zivel{Color:White}?
Jiste ze ano! Slysel jsem
tolik pribehu o tobe.
Jsem {Color:Green}Belari{Color:White}, badatel starozitnosti.
Jsem take, no, trochu vynalezce.
Vis, nemuzes se vratit do mesta
kvuli vsem tem sutinam...
Tady, mam neco, co by se
ti mohlo hodit.

en: Let me know if you find it useful.
cz: Dej mi vedet, jestli to shledas uzitecnym.

en:
So you like those {Color:Red}bombs{Color:White}, huh?
I still have some, so here you go.
cz:
Takze mas rad ty {Color:Red}bomby{Color:White}, ze?
Jeste par mam, tak si vezmi.

en:
I don't suppose you know where the
hot springs are, do you?
My current experiment requires
{Color:Blue}mineral-rich spring water{Color:White}.
cz:
Nevis nahodou, kde jsou
horke prameny, ze?
Muj aktualni experiment vyzaduje
{Color:Blue}mineralni pramenitou vodu{Color:White}.

en:
Eh? Did you bring me some {Color:Red}Mt. Crenel 
Mineral Water{Color:White}?
Thank you! At last, I can complete my
experiment! I must reward you!
cz:
Eh? Prinesl jsi mi {Color:Red}Mineralni
vodu z Mt. Crenel{Color:White}?
Diky! Konecne mohu dokoncit
svuj experiment! Musim te odmenit!

en: Well, back to my research.
cz: Tak, zpatky k mym vyzkumum.

en:
Wouldn't it be handy to have a bomb
that blew up only when you wanted?
cz:
Nebylo by uzitecne mit bombu,
ktera vybuchne, jen kdyz chces?

en:
I'm sorry, but I already gave you all
the bombs I have.
cz:
Omlouvam se, ale uz jsem ti dal
vsechny bomby, ktere jsem mel.

en:
You've brought a {Color:Red}Kinstone{Color:White}, haven't
you? Let's see if we can {Color:Blue}fuse {Color:White}ours.
cz:
Prinesl jsi {Color:Red}Kamen osudu{Color:White}, ze?
Uvidime, jestli je muzeme {Color:Blue}spojit{Color:White}.

en:
Excellent! A perfect match! And I
suspect this might result in an item!
cz:
Skvele! Dokonala shoda! A myslim,
ze by to mohlo vest k predmetu!

en:
You know, we really ought to try
fusing Kinstones sometime.
cz:
Vis, meli bychom nekdy zkusit
spojit Kameny osudu.

en:
At last, it's complete! The {Color:Red}Remote
Bomb{Color:White}! It blows up whenever you want!
If you ever need normal {Color:Red}bombs {Color:White}again,
just trade me back for them. So...
Want to trade for {Color:Red}Remote Bombs{Color:White}?
   {Choice:FF}Sure   {Choice:1F:10}No, thanks
cz:
Konecne je hotov! {Color:Red}Dalkove
rizena bomba{Color:White}! Vybuchne kdykoli chces!
Pokud budes nekdy potrebovat normalni
{Color:Red}bomby{Color:White}, prijd si je zase vymenit.
Chces vymenit za {Color:Red}Dalkove rizene bomby{Color:White}?
   {Choice:FF}Jasne   {Choice:1F:10}Ne, diky

en:
You traded for {Color:Red}Remote Bombs{Color:White}.

Press the button to use a bomb, then
press the button again to detonate it.
cz:
Vymenil sis za {Color:Red}Dalkove rizene bomby{Color:White}.

Stiskni tlacitko pro pouziti bomby,
pak stiskni znovu pro odpal.

en:
If you ever need a {Color:Red}Remote Bomb{Color:White}, just
say the word.
cz:
Pokud budes nekdy potrebovat
{Color:Red}Dalkove rizenou bombu{Color:White}, staci rici.

en:
You want to use normal {Color:Red}bombs {Color:White}again?
Just trade back those {Color:Red}Remote Bombs{Color:White}.
Want to trade for normal {Color:Red}bombs{Color:White}?
   {Choice:FF}Sure   {Choice:1F:13}Maybe later
cz:
Chces zase pouzivat normalni {Color:Red}bomby{Color:White}?
Proste vymen ty {Color:Red}Dalkove rizene bomby{Color:White}.
Chces vymenit za normalni {Color:Red}bomby{Color:White}?
   {Choice:FF}Jasne   {Choice:1F:13}Mozna pozdeji

Vymenil sis za normalni {Color:Red}bomby{Color:White}!

Az zas budes chtit {Color:Red}Dalkove rizene bomby{Color:White},
prijd za mnou.

en:
If you ever want to use normal {Color:Red}bombs{Color:White}
again, just come see me.
cz:
Az zas budes chtit pouzit normalni
{Color:Red}bomby{Color:White}, jen za mnou prijd.

en:
Tell me if you want to swap for
{Color:Red}Remote Bombs{Color:White}.
I can trade with you if you like.
   {Choice:FF}Sure   {Choice:1F:10}No, thanks
cz:
Rekni, jestli chces vymenit za
{Color:Red}Dalkove rizene bomby{Color:White}.
Muzu s tebou vymenit, jestli chces.
   {Choice:FF}Jasne   {Choice:1F:10}Ne, diky

en:
{Sound:01:E5}Hm... I've never seen an outfit like
that before. Are you a...human?
Oh, my! It's been quite some time
since any humans came here.
My name is {Color:Green}Festari{Color:White}. I watch the abbey,
as well as the shrine to the north.
You...seem to be having some trouble
with our language, don't you?
You could use a {Color:Red}Jabber Nut{Color:White}. It will
allow you to understand our tongue.
You should be able to find one in
the barrel house just south of here.
cz:
{Sound:01:E5}Hm... Takove obleceni jsem
jeste nevidel. Jsi ty...clovek?
Ach! Uz je to davno, co sem
nejaci lide prisli.
Jmenuji se {Color:Green}Festari{Color:White}. Hlidam opatstvi
i svatyni na severu.
Zda se...ze mas trosku problemy
s nasim jazykem, ze?
Hodil by se ti {Color:Red}Blabolovy orech{Color:White}.
Umozni ti rozumet nasi reci.
Mel bys ho najit v soudkovem
dome jizne odtud.

en:
{Sound:01:E5}You wish to go to the {Color:Green}shrine{Color:White}?
Very well. This way...
cz:
{Sound:01:E5}Chces jit do {Color:Green}svatyne{Color:White}?
Dobre. Tudy...

en:
Vile beasts have settled in recently.
Be careful: it is quite dangerous.
cz:
Odporne bestie se tam nedavno usadily.
Bud opatrny: je to velmi nebezpecne.

en:
{Sound:01:E5}You retrieved the {Color:Red}Earth Element {Color:White}from
that fiend-infested shrine?
Incredible!

Humans are amazing creatures.
The elder is sure to be amazed, too.
cz:
{Sound:01:E5}Ziskal jsi {Color:Red}Zemsky zivel {Color:White}z te
svatyne plne monster?
Neuveritelne!

Lide jsou uzasna stvoreni.
Starsi bude urcite tez ohromen.

en:
{Sound:01:E5}So you're on a quest to restore the
sacred blade so you can save the
princess? Yeah, I'm sure you'll
manage...
cz:
{Sound:01:E5}Takze jsi na vyprave obnovit
posvatnou cepel, abys mohl zachranit
princezna? Jo, jsem si jisty, ze
to zvladnes...

en:
{Sound:01:E5}So you've eaten the {Color:Red}Jabber Nut{Color:White},
and now you can understand us?
...

{07:1F:1C}
cz:
{Sound:01:E5}Takze ses najedl {Color:Red}Blabolovy orech{Color:White},
a ted nam rozumis?
...

{07:1F:1C}

en:
Sorry, but I know little about {Color:Red}swords{Color:White}.
I'm sure the {Color:Green}elder{Color:White} can help you.
cz:
Promin, ale o {Color:Red}mecich {Color:White}vim malo.
Jsem si jisty, ze {Color:Green}starsi{Color:White} ti pomuze.

en:
Oh, {Player}.

This must be the {Color:Red}Jabber Nut {Color:White}Festari
told you about.
Well, you'd better eat it if you plan
on making any progress at all.
cz:
Aha, {Player}.

Toto musi byt {Color:Red}Blabolovy orech{Color:White},
o kterem Festari mluvil.
Bude lepsi, kdyz ho snis, chces-li
vubec udelat nejaky pokrok.

en: {Sound:02:03}Pico riki poko ti po!
cz: {Sound:02:03}Pico riki poko ti po!

en:
{Sound:02:03}So you've eaten the {Color:Red}Jabber Nut{Color:White} and
now you can understand us...
The {Color:Green}elder {Color:White}said that humans can no
longer see us as they once could.
It's amazing that you can see us.
cz:
{Sound:02:03}Takze ses najedl {Color:Red}Blaboloveho orechu{Color:White}
a ted nam rozumis...
{Color:Green}Starsi {Color:White}rekl, ze lide nas jiz
nevidi tak, jak nas kdysi videli.
Je uzasne, ze nas vidis.

en:
{Sound:02:03}This is where we cultivate {Color:Blue}Pico Blooms{Color:White}.

The {Color:Red}Picolyte {Color:White}sold in the human town is
made from the {Color:Blue}nectar of our plants{Color:White}.
We sneak into town at night and leave
it there for the humans to find.
cz:
{Sound:02:03}Zde pestujeme {Color:Blue}Pico kvety{Color:White}.

{Color:Red}Picolyte {Color:White}prodavany v meste lidi je
vyroben z {Color:Blue}nektaru nasich rostlin{Color:White}.
V noci se plizime do mesta a
nechavame ho tam, aby ho lide nasli.

en:
South of here, there's a house
shaped like a barrel.
Inside, you will find a {Color:Red}Jabber Nut{Color:White}.

If you eat this {Color:Red}Jabber Nut{Color:White}, you will be
able to understand the Minish tongue.
cz:
Jizne odtud je dum ve
tvaru soudku.
Uvnitr najdes {Color:Red}Blabolovy orech{Color:White}.

Kdyz snis tento {Color:Red}Blabolovy orech{Color:White},
budes schopen rozumet Minish reci.

en:
We sneak our {Color:Blue}Pico Blooms{Color:White} to areas
near where the humans live.
Just having some of it makes
you incredibly lucky.
We're preparing for our next delivery
right now.
cz:
Plizime se s nasimi {Color:Blue}Pico kvety{Color:White}
do mist blizko lidi.
Staci mit trochu a mas
neuveritelne stesti.
Prave pripravujeme dalsi
doruceni.

en: Ruff! Ruff!
cz: Haf! Haf!

en:
{Sound:02:1A}Honestly! Where did Dad go this time?!?

I leave for just a few minutes, and he
locks up the ranch and takes off!
cz:
{Sound:02:1A}Vazne! Kam ted tata zase odesel?!?

Odejdu na par minut a on zamkne
ranc a zdrhne!

en:
I lost my key, and I can't get inside.
And the {Color:Red}spare key{Color:White}'s inside the house!
cz:
Ztratila jsem klic a nemuzu
dovnitr.
A {Color:Red}nahradni klic{Color:White} je v dome!

en:
{Sound:02:1A}What a pain. And I was thinking of
going into town to sell {Color:Red}Lon Lon Milk{Color:White}.
cz:
{Sound:02:1A}Jaka otrava. A ja premyslela,
ze zajdu do mesta prodat {Color:Red}Lon Lon mleko{Color:White}.

en:
Oh! Our one and only spare key!

I don't know how you got this, but
I can't thank you enough!
Tell me your name, sonny.

{04:12}{Player}? That's a great name.

If you ever need to go to {Color:Green}Lake Hylia{Color:White},
feel free to cut through our house.
cz:
Ach! Nas jedinny nahradni klic!

Nevim, jak jsi ho ziskal, ale
nemuzu ti dost podekovat!
Rekni mi svoje jmeno, synku.

{04:12}{Player}? To je skvele jmeno.

Pokud budes nekdy potrebovat jit
do {Color:Green}Jezera Hylia{Color:White}, klidne
pres nas dum.

en:
You really helped me out, sonny.

If you ever want to go to {Color:Green}Lake Hylia{Color:White},
use the shortcut out behind our ranch.
cz:
Opravdu jsi mi pomohl, synku.

Pokud budes nekdy chtit jit
do {Color:Green}Jezera Hylia{Color:White}, pouzij zkratku
za nasi rancem.

en:
{Sound:02:1A}Thank you, {Player}. Now, I can
finally get back into my house.
Well, I'd better be going. I have a
lot to do before I can leave town.
cz:
{Sound:02:1A}Diky, {Player}. Ted se konecne
mohu vratit do sveho domu.
Radeji uz pujdu. Mam hodne
prace, nez opustim mesto.

en: Nayhayhayyyy...
cz: Nayhayhayyyy...

en:
Well! If it isn't {Player}! I just
finished milking our pride and joy.
I'll tell you what, {Player}... Because
you did us such a big favor...
I'll sell you some milk at our special,
friends-only price.
If you ever need a {Color:Blue}quick burst of
strength{Color:White}, just drink it up!
And if you run out, just bring
your empty bottle back for a refill!
Buy some {Color:Red}Lon Lon Milk {Color:White}for 30 Rupees?
   {Choice:FF}Sure   {Choice:20:14}No, thanks
cz:
No! Neni to {Player}? Prave jsem

growing plants and making tools.
The {Color:Red}Minish Berries{Color:White} we grow here often
contain items that please the humans.

{Color:Red}Minish bobule{Color:White}, ktere zde pestujeme, casto

en:
{Sound:01:F9}There's a weird guy outside the village
who {Color:Blue}invents all kinds of tools{Color:White}.
He came to the village a while ago. We
thought maybe he was back for good.
But all he said was {Color:Blue}"Got any {Color:Red}milk{Color:Blue}?"{Color:White}

sometimes it's a stone.
We hide our lucky items in all sorts of
unexpected places.
But the real trick is making it tough
for humans to notice!

nekdy je to kamen.

{Sound:01:FD}I've been getting better at disguising
things so that humans won't notice 'em!
I love my job!
cz:
{Sound:01:FD}Zlepsuji se v maskovani veci
tak, aby si jich lide nevsimli!
Miluji svou praci!

en:
{Sound:02:05}Wow! Good job finding this place! There
aren't many people who visit me here.
cz:
{Sound:02:05}Fuj! Skvele, ze jsi to tady
nasel! Malokdo me tu navstivuje.

en: {Sound:01:FE}Hehhe! Great! Let's fuse now!
cz: {Sound:01:FE}Hehe! Skvele! Pojdme spojit!

{Color:Red}Kinstone {Color:White}and get really lucky?
Well, that's all thanks to items made
by us {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}!
You see, we thrive on making humans
happy. It gives us energy.
But we only do it in secret!
cz:
{Sound:01:F8}Slysel jsi o cestovatelich, kteri najdou
{Color:Red}Kamen osudu {Color:White}a maji stesti?
To je vse diky predmetum, ktere
delame my {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}!
Zijeme z toho, ze delame lidi
stastne. Dava nam to energii.
Ale delame to jen v tajnosti!

en:

stone and find something under it?
Well, those items were actually left
there by us {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}!
You see, we thrive on making humans
happy. It gives us energy.
But we only do it in secret!

cz:

stastnymi, ale delame to jen v tajnosti!

en:

used the portal between our worlds.
It brought them into the human world,
and they settled in this forest.
cz:
{Sound:01:FB}Nasi predkove, staroveci {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White},
pouzivali portal mezi nasimi svety.
Privedl je do sveta lidi
a oni se usadili v tomto lese.

en:
{Sound:01:FB}Our ancestors, the ancient {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White},
used the portal between our worlds.
It brought them here, into the human
world, and they settled in this forest.
The {Color:Green}elder {Color:White}says our cultures have
changed much since those old days.
cz:
{Sound:01:FB}Nasi predkove, staroveci {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White},
pouzivali portal mezi nasimi svety.
Privedl je sem, do sveta
lidi, a usadili se v tomto lese.
{Color:Green}Starsi {Color:White}rika, ze nase kultury se od
tech starych dob hodne zmenily.

en:
{Sound:02:03}If you want to reforge that sword, you
will need the help of an expert smith!
{Color:Green}Master Melari{Color:White} and his seven
apprentices can help you.
They live in the mountains, where they
can find all the ore they need.
I'm sure the {Color:Green}elder {Color:White}would tell you about
him if you asked.
cz:
{Sound:02:03}Pokud chces znovu vykovat mec,
budes potrebovat pomoc odborneho kovare!
{Color:Green}Mistr Melari{Color:White} a jeho sedm
ucnu ti mohou pomoci.
Ziji v horach, kde mohou
najit vsechnu potrebnou rudu.
Jsem si jisty, ze {Color:Green}starsi {Color:White}ti o nem
povi, kdyz se zeptas.

en:
{Sound:02:03}If you want that sword reforged, you
should see {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White}.
He and his apprentices are skilled in
the arts of metalworking.
That's why they live in the mountain:
so they can be close to the ore!
cz:
{Sound:02:03}Pokud chces ten mec znovu vykovat,
mel bys jit za {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White}.
On a jeho ucni jsou zbehli
v umeni kovarstvi.
Proto ziji v hore:
aby byli blizko rude!

en:
{Sound:01:FA}So how was old {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White}?

And were his apprentices singing their
usual work song?
cz:
{Sound:01:FA}Tak jaky byl stary {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White}?

A zpivali jeho ucni svou
obvyklou pracovni pisen?

en: Pico ricopi picoco copi!
cz: Pico ricopi picoco copi!

{Sound:01:F9}There are so many monsters around
these woods lately!
The elder said that even the {Color:Green}shrine {Color:White}to
the north is filled with monsters now!
cz:
{Sound:01:F9}V techto lesich je poslednich dnu
tolik monster!
Starsi rekl, ze i {Color:Green}svatyne {Color:White}na
severu je ted plna monster!

en:
{Sound:02:00}You fought all the monsters and took
the {Color:Red}Earth Element{Color:White} from the altar?
You humans are amazing.
cz:
{Sound:02:00}Bojoval jsi se vsemi monstry
a vzal {Color:Red}Zemsky zivel{Color:White} z oltare?
Vy lide jste uzasni.

en:
{Sound:02:00}You fought the monsters all the way to
the altar to get the {Color:Red}Earth Element{Color:White}?
Wow, humans are amazing!
cz:
{Sound:02:00}Bojoval jsi s monstry az k
oltari, abys ziskal {Color:Red}Zemsky zivel{Color:White}?
Wow, lide jsou uzasni!

en:
{Sound:01:F8}Hey, nice clothes...
I want to wear human clothes, too!
cz:
{Sound:01:F8}Hej, pekny obleceni...
Taky bych chtel nosit lidske obleceni!

en:
{Sound:01:F9}I was born and raised here, so I don't
know much about the outside world.
I hear there are HUGE green monsters
out there in the woods.
I can't believe you made it through
there alive! You must be really brave!
cz:
{Sound:01:F9}Narodil jsem se a vyrostl tady, takze
neznam moc vnejsi svet.
Slysel jsem, ze tam v lesich
jsou OBROVSKE zelene nestvury.
Neverim, ze jsi to prezil!
Musis byt opravdu statecny!

en:
{Sound:01:F9}That's it! I've decided!

When I grow up, I'm going to be human!
...I wonder how I'll do that...
cz:
{Sound:01:F9}Uz je to jasny! Rozhodl jsem se!

Az vyrostu, budu clovek!
...Zajimalo by me, jak to udelam...

en:
{Sound:01:FA}I'm getting set to leave for town and
visit some of my Minish friends there.
cz:
{Sound:01:FA}Chystam se odjet do mesta a
navstivit nekolik svych Minish pratel.

en:
{Sound:01:FB}We {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}live in Hyrule Town and other
places, too--not just in these woods.
cz:
{Sound:01:FB}My {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}zijeme v meste Hyrule
i jinde -- ne jen v techto lesich.

en:
{Sound:01:FC}Had you never seen any {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}before
you came here?
Really? That's so strange.
We Minish live all over the place!
cz:
{Sound:01:FC}Nikdy jsi predtim nevidel {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White},
nez jsi sem prisel?
Opravdu? To je tak divne.
My Minish zijeme vsude!

en:
{Sound:01:FE}We {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}live in Hyrule Town and other
places, too--not just in these woods.
cz:
{Sound:01:FE}My {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}zijeme v meste Hyrule
i jinde -- ne jen v techto lesich.

en:
{Sound:02:03}You probably haven't noticed, but lots
of {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}live right in {Color:Green}Hyrule Town{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:02:03}Asi sis toho nevsiml, ale hodne
{Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}zije prime v {Color:Green}meste Hyrule{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:02:02}Maybe I should just get out of this
sleepy little town and move to the city.
Or maybe I should go to the mountains.
The folks out there seem to have fun!
cz:
{Sound:02:02}Mozna bych se mel presunout z
toho ospaleho mestecka do velkomesta.
Nebo mozna do hor. Lide
tam se zdaji mit zabavu!

en:
{Sound:01:FB}I received a letter from my friend who
lives in the town library!
I wish I could live in town, too...
cz:
{Sound:01:FB}Dostal jsem dopis od kamarada,
kdo bydli v knihovne v meste!
Pral bych si, abych taky mohl
bydlet v meste...

en:
{Sound:02:05}Hello!

We're doing cutting-edge research on
Pico Blooms here.
You see that plant with the little bud?
We're working on ways to improve it!
cz:
{Sound:02:05}Ahoj!

Delame tady nejmodernejsi
vyzkum Pico kvetu.
Vidis tu rostlinku s malym pupenem?
Pracujeme na jejim vylepseni!

en:
{Sound:02:02}I need {Color:Red}milk {Color:White}to continue my improvements
on this Pico Bloom.
I wish someone would bring me some.
cz:
{Sound:02:02}Potrebuji {Color:Red}mleko{Color:White}, abych mohl
pokracovat ve vylepsovani tohoto Pico kvetu.
Kez by mi ho nekdo prinesl.

en:
{Sound:01:FD}Wow, thanks!
Now I can continue my research!
Come on back when this
flower blossoms!
cz:
{Sound:01:FD}Wow, diky!
Ted mohu pokracovat ve vyzkumu!
Vrat se, az kvet
rozkvete!

en:
{Sound:02:02}My new Pico Bloom hasn't blossomed yet.
Come back soon, though.
cz:
{Sound:02:02}Muj novy Pico kvet jeste nerozkvetl.
Ale vrat se brzy.

en:
{Sound:01:FF}Look! I succeeded in growing a {Color:Blue}Yellow
Pico Bloom{Color:White}! It's all thanks to you!
I'm so grateful for all your help!
cz:
{Sound:01:FF}Podivej! Podarilo se mi vypestovat
{Color:Blue}Zluty Pico kvet{Color:White}! Vse diky tobe!
Jsem tak vdecny za tvou pomoc!

en:
{Sound:01:FC}I am working on my next Pico Bloom
enhancement...
All I need is some {Color:Red}Mt. Crenel Mineral
Water{Color:White} to complete it.
But the mountain is so far away, and I
don't know how to get any.
I wish someone would bring me some.
cz:
{Sound:01:FC}Pracuji na dalsim vylepseni
Pico kvetu...
Vsechno, co potrebuji, je {Color:Red}Mineralni
voda z Mt. Crenel{Color:White}, abych to dokoncil.
Ale ta hora je tak daleko
a nevim, jak nejakou ziskat.
Kez by mi ji nekdo prinesl.

en:
{Sound:01:FD}Wow, thanks! This is just what I
needed to complete my research!
Come back when the bud blossoms!
cz:
{Sound:01:FD}Wow, diky! Prave tohle jsem
potreboval, abych dokoncil svuj vyzkum!
Vrat se, az pupen rozkvete!

en:
{Sound:01:FF}Look! I succeeded in growing a {Color:Blue}Blue
Pico Bloom{Color:White}! It's all thanks to you!
I'm so grateful for all your help!
cz:
{Sound:01:FF}Podivej! Podarilo se mi vypestovat
{Color:Blue}Modry Pico kvet{Color:White}! Vse diky tobe!
Jsem tak vdecny za tvou pomoc!

en:
{Sound:01:FC}I am working on my next Pico Bloom
enhancement...
But I need a {Color:Red}red potion{Color:White} to finish. If
only I knew where some could be found.
I wish someone would bring me some.
cz:
{Sound:01:FC}Pracuji na dalsim vylepseni
Pico kvetu...
Ale potrebuji {Color:Red}cerveny lektvar{Color:White}, abych
to dokoncil. Kdybych jen vedel, kde ho ziskat.
Kez by mi ho nekdo prinesl.

en:
{Sound:01:FD}Wow, thanks! This is just what I needed
to make that bud blossom!
Come back and see how it turns out!
cz:
{Sound:01:FD}Wow, diky! Prave tohle jsem
potreboval, aby ten pupen rozkvetl!
Vrat se a podivej, jak to dopadne!

en:
{Sound:01:FF}Look! I succeeded in growing an
{Color:Blue}Orange Pico Bloom{Color:White}, thanks to your help!
I'm so grateful to you!
cz:
{Sound:01:FF}Podivej! Podarilo se mi vypestovat
{Color:Blue}Oranzovy Pico kvet{Color:White}, diky tve pomoci!
Jsem ti tak vdecny!

en:
{Sound:01:FA}I'm taking a break from my research,
but I have lots of good ideas.
Super Pico Bloom...
Hyper Pico Bloom...
Cyber Pico Bloom...
Which one should I work on first?
cz:
{Sound:01:FA}Delam si pauzu od vyzkumu,
ale mam hodne dobrych napadu.
Super Pico kvet...
Hyper Pico kvet...
Kyber Pico kvet...
Na kterem mam pracovat prvni?
