mind, do let me know.
cz:
{Sound:02:01}Aha, promin tedy... Kdyz si to
rozmyslis, dej mi vedet.

en:
There should be some {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White} living here
in this forest.
Eh? Who are the {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}? Ah, yes,
how silly of me!
You humans call them "{Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}," but they
refer to themselves as the {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}!
Strange how, in the world of humans,
only this forest has kept the name...
Anyhow, deep in the forest they built a
tiny village, where many now live.
But if we're to enter the village, we'll
have to make you a touch smaller first.
Look for a tree stump. Then, I can
shrink you to the size of the "{Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}."
cz:
V tomto lese by meli
zit nejaci {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}.
Eh? Kdo jsou {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}? Ach, ano,
jak hloupe ode me!
Vy lide jim rikate "{Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}," ale oni
si rikaji {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}!
Zvlastni, ze ve svete lidi
si to jmeno zachoval jen tento les...
Mimochodem, hluboko v lese si postavili
malou vesnici, kde mnozi ted ziji.
Ale pokud mame do vesnice vstoupit,
musime te nejdriv trochu zmensit.
Hledej parez. Pak te mohu
zmensit na velikost "{Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}."

en:
{Sound:00:92}{04:10:00}Hold on for a moment, my boy! We've
stumbled across something important!
The world of the {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White} is very small.
You're far too big to meet them now.
Eh? Who are the {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}? Ah, yes! Silly
me! Allow me to explain...
You humans call them "{Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}," but they
refer to themselves as the {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}!
Strange how, in the world of humans,
only this forest has kept that name...
Anyhow, deep in the forest they built a
tiny village, where many now live.
But if we're to enter the village, we'll
have to make you a touch smaller first.
Look at that. At first glance, it
appears to be a mere stump, yes?
No! That stump is a {Color:Blue}portal{Color:White} used by
people long ago to adjust their size!
With my help, you can use it to {Color:Blue}shrink
down to Minish size{Color:White}.
Just stand on the stump and press {Key:Right}
to shrink.
To return to normal, stand next to the
stump and press {Key:Right}.
Get me up there, and we'll give
it a try.
cz:
{Sound:00:92}{04:10:00}Pockej chvilku, chlapce! Zakopli
jsme o neco duleziteho!
Svet {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White} je velmi maly.
Jsi na jejich setkani prilis velky.
Eh? Kdo jsou {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}? Ach, ano!
Hloupy ja! Dovol mi vysvetlit...
Vy lide jim rikate "{Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}," ale oni
si rikaji {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}!
Zvlastni, ze ve svete lidi
si to jmeno zachoval jen tento les...
Mimochodem, hluboko v lese si postavili
malou vesnici, kde mnozi ted ziji.
Ale pokud mame do vesnice vstoupit,
musime te nejdriv trochu zmensit.
Podivej na to. Na prvni pohled
vypada jako obycejny parez, ze?
Ne! Ten parez je {Color:Blue}portal{Color:White}, ktery lide
davno pouzivali k upraveni sve velikosti!
S mou pomoci ho muzes pouzit
ke {Color:Blue}zmenseni na Minish velikost{Color:White}.
Stoup na parez a stiskni {Key:Right}
ke zmenseni.
Abys se vratil do normalu, stoup vedle
parezu a stiskni {Key:Right}.
Dostan me tam nahoru
a vyzkousime to.

en:
Welcome to the world through the
eyes of the Minish!
Now, aren't you glad you saved me?
No need to thank me, though!
Portals that reduce your size are {Color:Blue}all
around, in different shapes and sizes{Color:White}.{Color:Blue}
{Color:White}If you want to return to normal, stand
next to a portal and press {Key:Right}.
But there is one thing you must know:
{Color:Blue}being Minish-sized is full of dangers{Color:White}!
Mere puddles at your normal size
are bottomless swamps to the Minish.
And as your companion, if anything bad
happens to you, it happens to me, too!
So proceed with caution, my lad! If not
for your sake, then for my own!
cz:
Vitej ve svete ocima
Minish!
A ted, nejsi rad, ze jsi me zachranil?
Nemusis mi ale dekovat!
Portaly, ktere te zmensi, jsou {Color:Blue}vsude
kolem, v ruznych tvarech a velikostech{Color:White}.{Color:Blue}
{Color:White}Pokud se chces vratit do normalu, stoup
vedle portalu a stiskni {Key:Right}.
Ale jednu vec musis vedet:
{Color:Blue}byt Minish velikosti je plne nebezpeci{Color:White}!
Obycejne kaluze v normalni velikosti
jsou pro Minish bezedne bahna.
A jako tvuj spolecnik, pokud se ti
neco zleho stane, stane se to i mne!
Takze postupuj opatrne, chlapce! Pokud ne
kvuli sobe, tak kvuli mne!

en:
The swamp in {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White} is
bottomless...I say.
To get across that swamp, you'll need
to {Color:Blue}run as swiftly as the wind blows{Color:White}...
cz:
Bahno v {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White} je
bezedne...povidam.
Abys jej prekonal, musis
{Color:Blue}bezet tak rychle jako vitr{Color:White}...

en:
A dark room settles my soul...I say.
Do not turn on the lights...I say.
cz:
Tmava mistnost mi tesi dusi...povidam.
Nerozsvecej svetla...povidam.

en:
Oh, dear. You found me out!
Don't tell anyone!
cz:
Achach. Prokoukl jsi me!
Nikomu to nerikej!

en:
Hello. I am Percy, poet laureate
of Hyrule.
And you are {Player}? Oh, no,
no! The pleasure is mine!
I travel all over the realm, writing
verse wherever I go.
But here I am, returning after a long
absence only to find the road blocked.
It wouldn't feel like such a waste if
I hadn't lost half of my {Color:Red}Kinstone{Color:White}!
When misfortune rains down upon
my head, it pours in torrents!
I think {Color:Blue}I may have dropped it in the
inn{Color:White} I stayed at last night...
I see no other course than to put
these tragic events to verse.
  {Color:Blue}I see stars beyond the rainbow,
  But I cannot reach them.
  Though the stone I lost is small,
  Large was its place in my heart.
cz:
Ahoj. Jsem Percy, dvorni
basnik Hyrule.
A ty jsi {Player}? Ach, ne,
ne! Potesenie je moje!
Cestuji po vsi zemi, pisu
verse, kdekoli jsem.
Ale tady jsem, vratil jsem se po dlouhem
ase, jen abych nasel cestu zablokovanou.
Necitil bych to jako plytvani, kdybych
byl neztratil pulku sveho {Color:Red}Kamene osudu{Color:White}!
Kdyz me nestesti zaliva,
lije se v proudech!
Myslim, ze {Color:Blue}jsem ho mozna nechal
v hostinci{Color:White}, kde jsem prespal minulou noc...
Nevidim jinou cestu, nez
tyto tragicke udalosti dat do versu.
  {Color:Blue}Vidim hvezdy za duhou,
  Ale nemohu je dosahnout.
  I kdyz je ztraceny kamenek maly,
  Velke bylo jeho misto v mem srdci.

en:
My way home is blocked. Alas!

And making matters worse, I lost one of
my {Color:Red}stone fragments{Color:White} in my travels.
When misfortune rains down upon
my head, it pours in torrents!
I wonder if I dropped that stone
fragment {Color:Blue}in the inn{Color:White} last night.
I see no other course than to put
these tragic events to verse.
  {Color:Blue}I see stars beyond the rainbow,
  But I cannot reach them.
  Though the stone I lost is small,
  Large was its place in my heart.
cz:
Ma cesta domu je zablokovana. Beda!

A jeste hur, ztratil jsem jeden ze
svych {Color:Red}kamennych utrzku{Color:White} na cestach.
Kdyz me nestesti zaliva,
lije se v proudech!
Zajimalo by me, jestli jsem ten
utrzek nechal {Color:Blue}v hostinci{Color:White} minulou noc.
Nevidim jinou cestu, nez
dat tyto tragedie do versu.
  {Color:Blue}Vidim hvezdy za duhou,
  Ale nemohu je dosahnout.
  I kdyz je ztraceny kamenek maly,
  Velke bylo jeho misto v mem srdci.

en:
Unfortunately, I only have one
{Color:Red}fragment{Color:White}. I'm sorry.
cz:
Bohuzel mam jen jeden
{Color:Red}utrzek{Color:White}. Promin.

en:
Oh, my! That {Color:Red}fragment{Color:White} looks just like
mine! They might even fit together!
cz:
Ach! Ten {Color:Red}utrzek{Color:White} vypada presne
jako muj! Mohly by dokonce sedet!

en:
Oh, perfect! They fit!

That's it! I've got it now!
The perfect verse!
  {Color:Blue}Apart or whole,
  These two are one.
  Two lost and broken halves,
  Like me and my beloved.
cz:
Ach, dokonale! Sedi!

To je ono! Uz to mam!
Dokonaly vers!
  {Color:Blue}Oddeleni ci celi,
  Tito dva jsou jednim.
  Dve ztracene a slomene polovice,
  Jako ja a ma mila.

en:
Oh, dear! {Player}!
Won't you listen to my verse?
When I finally returned to my home,
sweet home, a stranger was there!
I'm an extremely shy person, and I just
can't talk to someone I don't know!
So...I had to put my feelings to verse!

  {Color:Blue}While I was gone, did you break in
  To practice your thieving art?
  Even if you rob my home,
  You can never steal my heart.
cz:
Achach! {Player}!
Neposlechl by sis muj vers?
Kdyz jsem se konecne vratil domu
k sve mile, mile, cizinec byl tam!
Jsem nesmirne stydlivy clovek a nemuzu
mluvit s nekym, koho neznam!
Takze...sve pocity jsem dal do versu!

  {Color:Blue}Zatimco jsem byl pryc, vloupal ses,
  Abys si trenoval zlodejske umeni?
  I kdyz me okrades doma,
  Nikdy neukradnes me srdce.

en:
Oh, my! {Player}! Thanks to you, I can
finally go back in my house.
It's been totally rearranged, but I
think it's a good look!
I've put my feelings of gratitude
to verse...
  {Color:Blue}The way made safe, I came back home
  To find me inside, all alone.
  In my chest, my poor heart aches,
  But for you I feel the deepest thanks!
cz:
Ach! {Player}! Diky tobe se
konecne mohu vratit do sveho domu.
Je uplne prerovnany, ale
myslim, ze je to dobra podoba!
Sve pocity vdecnosti jsem
dal do versu...
  {Color:Blue}Cesta bezpecna, vratil jsem se domu
  a nasel se uvnitr, uplne sam.
  V hrudi mi ubohe srdce boli,
  Ale za tebe citim ty nejhlubsi diky!

en:
What? You're going to quit?
Well, come again.
cz:
Co? Chces skoncit?
Tak prijd zase.

en:
Oh, {Player}!

Did you come all the way here just to
{Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones{Color:White} with me?
cz:
Aha, {Player}!

Prisel jsi az sem jen proto,
abys se mnou {Color:Blue}spojoval Kameny osudu{Color:White}?

en:
Oh, just a moment...

My dresser is entirely stuffed full
of these icky blue seashells.
Would you clean them out for me?
They're so...smelly. Please?
cz:
Ach, chvilku...

Moje kredence je uplne prepchana
temi protivnymi modrymi muslemi.
Vyklidil bys mi je?
Jsou tak...smrdute. Prosim?

en:
Oh! Oh, thank you! You're the one who
returned me to normal, aren't you?
I don't know how you did it, but
I can't thank you enough...
Listen... Have you seen how strange
the {Color:Green}king {Color:White}has been lately?
That's because it's not the king at all!
It's {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}! He's taken over the castle!
One by one, he turned us all to stone.
Everyone, cursed by his evil magic...
Then, the monsters arrived. Even
paralyzed, I saw it all...
I only pray it's not too late to undo
his evil...
cz:
Ach! Diky! Ty jsi ten, kdo
me vratil do normalu, ze?
Nevim, jak jsi to udelal, ale
nemuzu ti dost podekovat...
Poslouchej... Vsimnul sis, jak divny
byl {Color:Green}kral {Color:White}poslednich dnu?
Protoze to vubec neni kral!
Je to {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}! Prevzal hrad!
Jednoho po druhem promenil
nas vsechny v kamen.
Vsichni, prokleti jeho zlou magii...
Pak prisly nestvury. I paralyzovan,
jsem to vse videl...
Jen se modlim, ze neni prilis pozde
zvratit jeho zlo...

en:
{Player}! We need your help!

{Color:Green}Vaati {Color:White}took our petrified princess to
the roof of the castle...
He must be planning something fiendish.
You must stop him!
cz:
{Player}! Potrebujeme tvou pomoc!

{Color:Green}Vaati {Color:White}vzal nasi zkamenelou princeznu
na strechu hradu...
Musi neco zleho planovat.
Musis ho zastavit!

en:
The real {Color:Green}king of Hyrule {Color:White}must be locked
up somewhere in the castle...
Please find him. As soon as we've
recovered, we'll start looking, too.
cz:
Skutecny {Color:Green}kral Hyrule {Color:White}musi byt
zavren nekde v hrade...
Prosim, najdi ho. Jakmile se
zotavime, zaneme taky hledat.

en:
Oh! Thank you for restoring me.
I feel so much better now!
Don't worry about me. I'll be fine.
Now, go help the others!
cz:
Ach! Diky za obnoveni.
Citim se ted mnohem lepe!
Neboj se o me. Budu v poradku.
A ted, jdi pomoct ostatnim!

en:
Leave this to us!
You go save {Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White}!
cz:
Nech to na nas!
Jdi zachranit {Color:Green}princeznu Zeldu{Color:White}!

en:
Don't worry--we'll protect the king.
You have to go save {Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White}!
cz:
Neboj se--budeme chranit krale.
Musis jit zachranit {Color:Green}princeznu Zeldu{Color:White}!

en:
Gah! I hate to admit it, but we're
just no match for those beasts!
cz:
Gah! Nerad to priznavam, ale
na ty bestie proste nestacime!

en:
Oh! {Player}!

Are you the one who broke the
curse and returned me to normal?
You've grown quite brave since
I last saw you, I must say.
But, oh, how this castle has suffered
while I was under {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}'s curse...
Is this all the work of one man?

As {Color:Green}king of Hyrule{Color:White}, I must do
something about this villain...
But... Ah, I'm old, and I would only
hold you back.
{Player}, you have the {Color:Red}sacred blade{Color:White}
now. We must rely on you.
Please! You must find a way to rescue
my {Color:Green}Zelda{Color:White}.
Take this key. You can use it to get
out of the castle from the basement.
cz:
Ach! {Player}!

Jsi to ty, kdo zlomil klatbu
a vratil me do normalu?
Musim rici, ze jsi hodne
zestatecnil, co jsem te videl.
Ale, ach, jak tento hrad trpel,
zatimco jsem byl pod {Color:Green}Vaatiho{Color:White} klatbou...
Je toto vse dilo jednoho muze?

Jako {Color:Green}kral Hyrule{Color:White} musim s tim
zlodejem neco udelat...
Ale... Ach, jsem stary a jen
bych te zdrzoval.
{Player}, ted mas {Color:Red}posvatnou cepel{Color:White}.
Musime se spolehat na tebe.
Prosim! Musis najit zpusob,
jak zachranit mou {Color:Green}Zeldu{Color:White}.
Vezmi tento klic. Muzes ho pouzit,
abys se dostal z hradu ze sklepa.

en:
If I were to join you, I fear I would
only be a hindrance.
Please, {Player}, you must find a way
to save my daughter.
cz:
Kdybych se k tobe pridal, obavam se,
ze bych byl jen na obtiz.
Prosim, {Player}, musis najit zpusob,
jak zachranit mou dceru.

en: Come on! Let's look around!
cz: Pojd! Rozhlednem se!

en:
{Player}, there's a storyteller here!
We should stop and listen to--
Oh! I wonder what's over there...
cz:
{Player}, tady je vypravec!
Meli bychom se zastavit a poslouchat--
Ach! Zajimalo by me, co je tam...

en:
So the {Color:Green}Picori {Color:White}ARE real! My father
always told me they were.
Oh! Look at that!
cz:
Takze {Color:Green}Picori {Color:White}JSOU skutecni!
Otec mi vzdy rikal, ze jsou.
Ach! Podivej!

en:
Say, wasn't there going to be a {Color:Blue}sword-
fighting tournament{Color:White} at the castle?
I wonder who won this year...

Oh, wow! Over here!
cz:
Rekni, nemel byt v hrade
{Color:Blue}turnaj v sermovani{Color:White}?
Zajimalo by me, kdo letos vyhral...

Ach, ty jo! Sem!

en:
{Player}! Where are you going?
Over here! This way!
cz:
{Player}! Kam jdes?
Sem! Tudy!

en:
Welcome to the {Color:Blue}Picori Festival{Color:White}!

They say that, every hundred years,
the Picori come to Hyrule...
And this is the 100th year, to the day,
since the last time the Picori were here!
cz:
Vitej na {Color:Blue}Festivalu Piccoru{Color:White}!

Rikaji, ze kazdych sto let
prijdou Picori do Hyrule...
A toto je stotny rok, do dne,
od posledni doby, kdy tady Picori byli!

en:
Long, long ago, and then even longer
before that...
Evil creatures appeared in the world
of humans.
They were powerful, frightening
beasts, and they created such trouble!
But then the {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White} came from the sky,
bringing humans powerful magic.
With the magic light force and the
Picori Blade, the beasts were repelled.
And the world of humans once more
knew peace, thanks to the Picori.
So as not to forget our gratitude, we
hold this festival each year.
Now, remember, little ones... The Picori
only appear before good little children.
If you only do bad deeds, you will
never get to see them! So be good!
cz:
Kdysi davno a jeste davneji nez to...
Zle stvureni se objevila ve
svete lidi.
Byly to mocne, desive nestvury
a delaly tolik potizi!
Ale pak prisli {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White} z nebe
a prinesli lidem mocnou magii.
S magickou svetelnou silou a
Picori cepeli byly bestie odrazeny.
A svet lidi zase poznal
mir, diky Picori.
Abychom nezapomneli, kazdy rok
drzime tento festival.
A ted si pamatuj, mali... Picori
se zjevi jen dobrym malym detem.
Kdyz budes zly, nikdy je
neuvidis! Tak bud hodny!

en:
I don't believe in the Picori!

I'm not a kid anymore! I'm too old to
believe in any stupid old fairy tales!
cz:
Neverim v Picori!

Uz nejsem dite! Jsem prilis stary,
abych veril v hloupe stare pohadky!

en:
Do you think I'll really see the Picori
if I'm on my best behavior all the time?
cz:
Myslis, ze opravdu uvidim Picori,
kdyz budu porad ten nejlepsi?

en:
Come on up! Come one, come all!
Gather round and have a look-see!
I'm having a huge sale on all manner
of delicious and festive vegetables!
cz:
Pojdte nahoru! Pojdte, vsichni!
Sejdete se a podivejte se!
Mam obrovsky vyprodej vsech
druhu chutne festivalove zeleniny!

en:
Oh, hi! Are you enjoying the festival?
It's so much fun!
I'm so happy to be here! And my fresh
fruits are just delicious! Buy some!
cz:
Ach, ahoj! Bavis se na festivalu?
Je to takova zabava!
Jsem tak stastna, ze tu jsem!
A me cerstve ovoce je delikatni! Kup!

en:
Come one! Come all! Try your luck,
and win incredible prizes!
cz:
Pojdte, vsichni! Zkuste stesti
a vyhrajte neuveritelne ceny!

en:
Hey, guy, have you ever seen the
Picori? I saw one just the other day!
It wore a red cone-shaped hat, and
it was really small...
And it was standing inside my dad's
shoe! I really saw it! I swear!
cz:
Hej, kluku, videl jsi nekdy
Picori? Ja jsem jednoho videl!
Mel cerveny kuzelovity klobouk
a byl opravdu maly...
A stal v tatinkove bote!
Opravdu jsem ho videl! Prisaham!

en:
So, so, so... I've been good all year?
Like, all year long?
And you know how the Picori only
show themselves if you've been good?
And so, so, so I'm just waiting for
the Picori to come and play with me.
cz:
Takze, takze, takze... Byl jsem
hodny cely rok? Fakt cely rok?
A vis, jak se Picori zjevi
jen kdyz jsi byl hodny?
A takze cekam na Picori,
az prijdou a budou si se mnou hrat.

en:
Only once every hundred years does
the mystic doorway open.
This is the door that links the human
world to the world of the {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}.
When this door opens, the {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White} can
enter our world. And guess what!
This marks the hundredth year
since they last appeared here!
I'm sure something wonderful is
going to happen at this festival!
cz:
Jen jednou za sto let se
myticke dvere otevrou.
To jsou dvere, ktere spojuji lidsky
svet se svetem {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}.
Kdyz se tyto dvere otevrou, {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White} mohou
vstoupit do naseho sveta. A hadej co!
Toto je stotny rok od
posledniho, kdy se tu objevili!
Jsem si jisty, ze se stane
neco uzasneho na tomto festivalu!

en:
Each year, there is a sword-fighting
tournament at the {Color:Blue}Picori Festival{Color:White}.
This year's tournament is already over.
I couldn't believe how fast it went!
I hear {Color:Green}the victor was a mysterious
man dressed entirely in black{Color:White}.
cz:
Kazdy rok se kona turnaj
v sermovani na {Color:Blue}Festivalu Piccoru{Color:White}.
Letosni turnaj uz je pryc.
Nemohl jsem uverit, jak rychle to bylo!
Slysel jsem, ze {Color:Green}vitezem byl zahadny
muz obleceny cely v cerne{Color:White}.

en:
They say the Picori bring happiness
to all the humans they meet...
I wonder when they will bring
happiness to me...
cz:
Rikaji, ze Picori prinaseji stesti
vsem lidem, ktere potkaji...
Zajimalo by me, kdy prinesou
stesti mne...

en:
Are you enjoying yourself, {Player}?
This is the biggest festival in {Color:Green}Hyrule{Color:White}!
If you don't stop to enjoy it,
you'll miss out on all the fun!
cz:
Uzivas si, {Player}?
Toto je nejvetsi festival v {Color:Green}Hyrule{Color:White}!
Kdyz se nezastavis a neuzijes si to,
prijdes o vsechnu zabavu!

en:
I've been on the road for a while.
I came back in time for the festival.
It feels wonderful to be back in Hyrule
again, in this joyous time!
I... I must put these feelings
into verse!
cz:
Uz jsem chvili na cestach.
Vratil jsem se prave vcas na festival.
Je uzasne byt zase v Hyrule,
v teto radostne dobe!
Ja... musim tyto pocity
dat do versu!

en:
I love festivals. It's like seeing your
town transform into another world!
It really gives you a chance to think
about how well we have it here...
cz:
Miluji festivaly. Je to jako videt
sve mesto promeneno v jiny svet!
Opravdu ti to da sanci premyslet,
jak dobre to tady mame...

en:
People from all over the place come to
Hyrule Town for the {Color:Blue}Picori Festival{Color:White}.
cz:
Lide ze vsech mist prichazi do
mesta Hyrule na {Color:Blue}Festival Piccoru{Color:White}.

en:
You're the boy from old Master
Smith's place, right?
I'm sure you know this, but he's the
best swordsmith Hyrule's ever seen!
Every year, I enter the tournament
trying to win that sword of his.
I haven't won yet, and maybe I never
will, but the tournament was awesome!
The winner this year was a new face.
I've been wondering where he's from.
He used some incredible techniques and
won the whole tourney in record time!
cz:
Ty jsi ten kluk od stareho Mistra
Smithe, ze?
Jiste to vis, ale je to
nejlepsi kovar mecu v Hyrule vsech dob!
Kazdy rok se ucastnim turnaje,
abych vyhral jeho mec.
Jeste jsem nikdy nevyhral a mozna
nikdy nevyhraju, ale turnaj byl super!
Vitez letos byla nova tvar.
Zajimalo by me, odkud je.
Pouzil neuveritelne techniky a
vyhral cely turnaj v rekordnim case!

en:
I've been dispatched from {Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White}
up north to watch over the festivities.
cz:
Byl jsem povolan z {Color:Green}hradu Hyrule{Color:White}
na severu, abych dohlizel na oslavy.

en: I've never seen the {Color:Green}Picori {Color:White}before...
cz: Jeste jsem nikdy nevidel {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}...

en: You two must be great friends!
cz: Vy dva musite byt velci kamaradi!

en:
I'm going to look for {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}! Mom said
there'd be {Color:Green}Picori {Color:White}at the festival!
cz:
Jdu hledat {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}! Mama rikala,
ze budou {Color:Green}Picori {Color:White}na festivalu!

en:
I saw it! There was a {Color:Green}Picori {Color:White}here
just a second ago! No, really!
cz:
Videl jsem to! Tam byl {Color:Green}Picori {Color:White}
prave pred chvilkou! Ne, opravdu!

en:
This is my first ever {Color:Blue}Picori Festival{Color:White}!
So...where are all the {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}, anyway?
cz:
Toto je muj vubec prvni {Color:Blue}Festival Piccoru{Color:White}!
Takze...kde jsou vsichni {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}?

en:
Day and night, he's going on and on
about Picori this and Picori that!
Doesn't he know they're nothing but a
silly fairy tale to make kids behave?
cz:
Ve dne v noci mluvi o Picori
toto a Picori tamto!
Nevi, ze jsou to jen hloupa
pohadka, aby deti byly hodne?

en:
I'm just on my way back from seeing
the tournament at {Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White}.
Let me tell you! Watching all those
sword fights made me hungry!
cz:
Prave se vracim ze sledovani
turnaje v {Color:Green}hrade Hyrule{Color:White}.
Rikam ti! Sledovani vsech tech
souboju me udelalo hlade!

en:
Phew... Preparing for the festival left
me absolutely exhausted...
